New admission_permits() refuses a non-dict, an unrecognised schema, a partial receipt (missing any of can_admit/measured/pressure_pct/available_gb/tier), an unstamped receipt, and one older than ADMISSION_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_S=30s — each with a distinct reason so a policy refusal stays separable from a broken receipt. Wired at the two heavy-lane authorization sites. Test fixtures that handed the gate bare {'can_admit': True} dicts were updated to produce production-shaped snapshots via _admission_snapshot(); those fixtures were testing a shape production never emits, which is why the permissive reading looked safe. Tests: tests/test_admission_receipts_are_complete_and_fresh.py (19).
title: Missing admission fields are interpreted as permission

note: Both overstated claims bounded, and one turned out to be false in code as well as in prose. (1) The 'small model + large datastore matches a much bigger model' line is now attributed to the kNN-LM literature and explicitly marked 'not a measurement of this implementation... a mechanism, not a capability', since nothing here benchmarks against a larger model. (2) 'generation never degrades below the raw model' claimed more than fail-open delivers; the docstring now separates What IS guaranteed (no neighbours above the gate / lambda~0 / any exception -> lm_probs returned UNCHANGED) from What is NOT guaranteed (a blend that fires can be wrong — the similarity gate exists because confidently-recalled neighbours from another fact once outvoted the exact match). (3) Found while testing the narrow claim: it was not actually true. The except list stopped at TypeError/ValueError/KeyError/AttributeError/ZeroDivisionError/FloatingPointError, so a RuntimeError/OSError/IndexError/OverflowError/MemoryError from a FAISS- or numpy-backed query escaped into the token loop and killed the generation the contract exists to protect. Exception set widened to match the promise. Tests: tests/test_nonparametric_memory_claims_are_bounded.py (10).
title: Implementation comments overstate demonstrated capacity and safety

note: Added SubstrateReading (schema aura.substrate_reading.v1) carrying values + sourced channels + defaulted list + coverage fraction + degraded flag + read_at freshness, so a dead substrate no longer reads identically to a calm one — the distinction inference temperature/top_p/token-budget are derived from. Found while writing it: a SINGLE try/except wrapped every channel read, so the first failing service silently skipped all the rest (one unavailable homeostasis engine blanked phi, free_energy, valence, arousal, neurochemistry, affect, active inference and the whole causal vector, and the result was still returned as an ordinary substrate state). Each of the 7 channels now has its own guard and records a per-channel degradation. _read_substrate() keeps its historical dict signature so no caller changes. Tests: tests/test_substrate_reading_reports_its_coverage.py (10).
title: Partial and total substrate failures collapse to healthy defaults

note: Replaced floor-stride pooling with np.array_split over the whole vector, so all 64 buckets together cover every element regardless of divisibility. Measured before/after: size 200 covered 192 (8 neurons dropped on every call), size 1000 covered 960 (40 dropped); both now cover 100%, and a change confined to the previously-dropped tail now moves the output where it used to be invisible. Sizes divisible by 64 were always correct and are pinned unchanged. Also corrected the comment: it said 'hash-project', which is a different operation with different collision behaviour — it is contiguous mean-pooling, and the comment now says so. Tests: tests/test_composite_projection_covers_every_neuron.py (22).
title: Composite projection silently drops trailing neurons

note: Merge identity no longer trusts a caller-supplied id alone. seen_events maps event_id -> the content fingerprint (stage, method, reasons, deterministic, before/after chars, before/after sha256) it was first seen with. Same id + same content = the copied-receipt duplicate this dedupe exists for, still dropped. Same id + DIFFERENT content = a collision: the entry is kept under its content identity and a degradation is recorded, because losing a real mutation from a user-facing-answer audit trail is worse than carrying a redundant one. A differing after_sha256 alone is enough to keep both. Legacy (no-id) entries keep their existing content-tuple identity, minus the sequence number that varies by position. Tests: tests/test_mutation_ledger_survives_id_collisions.py (10).
title: Caller-controlled event IDs can suppress distinct mutations

note: Caps kept (a live belief graph should not get an unbounded logging sweep) but the result now states its own completeness. AuditReport gains contradiction_scan_considered/_total/_truncated, contradiction_reporting_capped, a coverage fraction and contradiction_result_is_complete; __str__ appends '[partial scan: N/M beliefs]' so a truncated audit can no longer read identically to a clean one. Measured: a 5,003-belief graph containing 3 real contradictions reported 0 because all three lay past the 500 cap — it now reports 0 with coverage 0.10 and complete=False, and logs that the count is a LOWER BOUND. Also added the missing ordering guarantee: eligible beliefs are sorted by id before truncation, so the examined subset is deterministic — previously the truncation was arbitrarily partial and a contradiction could appear and vanish between audits with no change to the beliefs. Tests: tests/test_contradiction_scan_reports_its_coverage.py (11).
title: Contradiction scanning silently ignores most large graphs

note: All three parts. (1) Deadline: the model call runs under asyncio.wait_for with DELIBERATION_TIMEOUT_S=45s (per-call override via deliberation_timeout_s), so a wedged model can no longer stall the decision and everything waiting on it. (2) Typed fallback: TimeoutError and provider errors (RuntimeError/AttributeError/TypeError/ValueError/OSError) are caught and turned into a Decision carrying metadata.degraded, deliberated=False, confidence 0.0 and an explaining reason — asyncio.CancelledError is deliberately re-raised, since cancellation is the caller's decision. This matters because _parse falls back to actions[0], so a failed deliberation previously returned a well-formed Decision naming a real action, indistinguishable from a considered choice. (3) Silent downgrade: when _native_system2_deliberate returns None the drop to the weaker ordinary route is recorded as metadata.native_system2_declined and in the trace. Tests: tests/test_deliberation_is_bounded_and_receipted.py (10).
title: Ordinary generation has no deadline or typed fallback

note: Two of the three limits already REJECT rather than truncate — normalize_cognitive_context raises past 6 items and past 400 chars — so a caller cannot quietly over-send; both are now pinned by test so a future change to truncate instead of reject fails loudly. The token limit was the real silent drop: encoding a 400-char memory can exceed 64 tokens and the tail went with nothing recorded, making a slot seeded from half a memory indistinguishable from one seeded from all of it. _embed_cognitive_context now records per-item requested/admitted/dropped token counts with the source and context_role, exposed via cognitive_context_admission() (schema aura.cognitive_context_admission.v1) carrying complete, truncated_items, dropped_tokens_total and the applied limits. The record is per-episode: _validate_cognitive_context resets it. Tests: tests/test_cognitive_context_admission_is_receipted.py (10).

note: Replay now rebuilds each queued record (_replay_record returns None for an unknown kind rather than crashing the sweep), computes its hash_key, skips it when _is_duplicate says it already committed, and calls _mark_committed on success — the first commit path already did all of this and replay did none of it. Dedup marks are saved BEFORE the queue rewrite so a crash between the two fails in the direction that prevents duplicates. The rewrite failure was 'pass # no-op: intentional' and now records a degradation: dedup absorbs the duplicate but a queue that cannot drain is still a durability fault. Verified end to end — a record committed in sweep 1 and returned by a failed rewrite commits 0 times in sweep 2; a distinct record still commits; a FAILED commit is neither drained nor marked. Tests: tests/test_replay_does_not_duplicate_writes.py (9).
title: Queue replay can duplicate every successful write

note: send() now returns a typed SendOutcome(delivered, reason) instead of None. Each of the six previously-indistinguishable drop paths is named: bus_not_running, connection_closed, pipe_broken, write_suppression_window, write_backpressure, write_timeout, pipe_closed:<Err>, send_error:<Err>, transport_loop_error:<Err> — the swallowed RuntimeError included. Fire-and-forget semantics are unchanged (no caller blocks, nothing new raises) and the return value was previously unused, so existing callers are unaffected; a legacy None from an inner path is treated as delivered rather than reported as a drop it never was. SendOutcome.__bool__ makes 'if not await bus.send(...)' natural. Tests: tests/test_bus_send_reports_delivery.py (10).
title: Fire-and-forget silently drops messages under normal failure states

note: The 'except (...): pass' around ensure_defensive_runtime_active is gone. Backend activation failure now records a warning degradation naming the consequence (quarantine and firewall actions will not reach the host) and the immune object carries enforcement_backends_active / enforcement_backends_error so any surface can tell a decision-only immune system from an armed one. OSError added to the caught set (packet-filter and ARP backends raise it). The decision layer genuinely works without the backends so activation stays best-effort and the immune system is still returned — refusing to return one would remove detection too. The logic was promoted out of a closure in _register_all_services_body into module-level install_immune_enforcement so the behaviour is testable without booting the container; an unannotatable (slotted/frozen) immune object degrades rather than taking the boot down. Tests: tests/test_immune_enforcement_gap_is_visible.py (11).
title: Immune system silently ignores enforcement backend failure

note: The 'except (...): return' around store.emit is gone. A failed receipt now records a warning degradation naming the consequence ('state mutation X applied but its receipt was not emitted; the audit trail is missing this change'), increments a failure counter and retains the last error. Receipts stay best-effort — a broken store must not stop the closed loop, and the emit still cannot raise — but the failure is countable via receipt_health() (schema aura.closed_loop_receipt_health.v1: emitted/failed/unstored/coverage/complete/last_error). 'No store configured' is counted SEPARATELY from 'store failed', because unreceipted-by-design and receipting-is-broken need different answers; zero attempts reports 0.0 coverage rather than full. OSError added to the caught set. Tests: tests/test_closed_loop_receipt_failures_are_visible.py (11).
title: Receipt failures are silently ignored

title: Excess context seeds are silently dropped

note: Added CorpusParseReport (schema aura.curated_corpus_parse.v1) and load_corpus_with_report(): total_bullets, parsed, unmatched, uncategorised, before_library_heading, dropped, complete and up to 5 samples of the failing lines. A real loss now records a warning degradation. Skipping stays the behaviour (one typo must not empty the library) — what changed is that the skip is counted and the failing text is shown. Deliberately does NOT count preamble as loss: measured against the real corpus, all 12 skipped bullets were instructional prose before '# The library' and unmatched==0, so counting them would make the report cry wolf on a healthy file and get it muted, which is how the original silence returns. load_corpus() keeps its list signature so no caller changes. note: Numeric-input class fix. Added core/runtime/numeric_guards.py (bounded_float/unit_float/positive_float/bounded_int/is_finite_number) as the single shared primitive, replacing a dozen near-identical private helpers that meant fixing one site taught the others nothing. Non-finite input is REJECTED to a caller-stated default rather than clamped, because clamping is what failed: min(max(nan,lo),hi) returns nan since every NaN comparison is False. Site: belief confidence. Belief confidence: a NaN belief won the top-5 prompt injection outright. Scheduler: a NaN interval passed '< 0' validation then made 'now-last_run >= interval' False forever (registered, healthy, never ran) — zero is KEPT as 'every tick', which is bounded by the scheduler cadence and relied on by the suite. Volition: NaN inquiry score sorted as highest priority (already fixed in-place, verified). Timeout: bounded to (0,600] at a subprocess boundary. Quality: NaN skipped the heuristic fallback AND became the stored score that rotation sorts on. Reliability: one NaN-reporting service made the whole global stability mean NaN. Tests: tests/test_numeric_guards.py (39).

Site: finetune quality. Belief confidence: a NaN belief won the top-5 prompt injection outright. Scheduler: a NaN interval passed '< 0' validation then made 'now-last_run >= interval' False forever (registered, healthy, never ran) — zero is KEPT as 'every tick', which is bounded by the scheduler cadence and relied on by the suite. Volition: NaN inquiry score sorted as highest priority (already fixed in-place, verified). Timeout: bounded to (0,600] at a subprocess boundary. Quality: NaN skipped the heuristic fallback AND became the stored score that rotation sorts on. Reliability: one NaN-reporting service made the whole global stability mean NaN. Tests: tests/test_numeric_guards.py (39).
title: Caller quality accepts non-finite and out-of-range values

note: tick_boredom now bounds current_fe through bounded_float (default = the last good reading, minimum 0). 'nan < BOREDOM_FE_CEILING' is False, so a NaN took the 'prediction error present' branch and drained boredom by 3 every tick, making the novelty threshold unreachable; and because _last_fe_value was overwritten with the NaN, every later fe_delta was NaN too, killing the surprise-spike relief. One bad reading disabled the drive permanently in both directions. Tests: tests/test_numeric_guards.py::TestOneBadReadingCannotDisableADrive.
title: Non-finite free energy can corrupt boredom state

note: record_turn now bounds response_quality (unit_float) plus the token counts feeding the division and the topic counts feeding the subtraction (bounded_int). 'nan > 0.6' is False, so a NaN quality silently counted as a FAILED turn, and success_rate drives the rampancy/metastability verdict — corrupt input produced a confident judgement about her cognitive health built on a non-judgement rather than an error. Verified the metastability score stays finite under fully corrupt input and a genuinely good turn still counts as success. Tests: tests/test_numeric_guards.py::TestCorruptQualityIsNotAJudgement.

note: All nine TelemetryPayload gauges now carry a declared range and are enforced by a mode='before' field_validator routed through bounded_float. ge/le alone would NOT have closed this: pydantic compares, and every comparison with NaN is False, so a NaN slips past a lower bound it never trips — the value has to be rejected explicitly. Enforcement CLAMPS rather than rejects on purpose: the payload is built inside the heartbeat and published to the websocket, so a ValidationError there kills the telemetry stream and freezes the dashboard on its last good frame while the runtime looks healthy — a gauge pinned at 100 is a visible wrong, a frozen dashboard is an invisible one. Percentages bound to [0,100], consciousness scores to [0,1], each with its own fallback. Tests: tests/test_numeric_guards.py::TestTelemetryGaugesAreBounded.

note: AdapterError.__post_init__ now enforces what the annotations only described: kind is coerced to AdapterErrorKind (unrecognised values become UNKNOWN rather than raising), message is stringified, retryable is booled, metadata is forced to a dict, and retry_after_s is bounded to [0,3600] via bounded_float. The concrete failure was __str__ raising AttributeError on self.kind.value for a bare-string kind — an error object that crashes while being REPORTED destroys the context of the original failure it was carrying. retry_after_s feeds a sleep, where NaN compares False against every bound, a negative is an instant retry storm and an enormous value is a hang. note: ok meant three things: confirmed, self-corrected, and never-ran. An empty response from a missing strong tier became ok=True with the original answer. The verdict now carries an explicit CrossTierStatus and a VerificationGrade from the runtime's single outcome vocabulary - UNAVAILABLE grades NONE and still serves the answer (a missing verifier must not block a turn) while verified is False. A correction is CORRECTION_PROPOSED at grade ASSERTED, never certified, because the same call that found the error wrote the replacement. Parser is line-anchored on an exact schema, so prose, 'not corrected:' and echoed text no longer parse, and conflicting verdicts refuse rather than tie-break. Untrusted text is fenced with an unpredictable suffix and the data-not-instructions directive follows it, so an answer cannot inject its own verdict. Generate errors broadened to OSError/ConnectionError/TimeoutError and bounded by a 90s deadline. to_dict carries status, grade, corrected, truncated, latency, provenance and a HASH of the raw verdict rather than the text. Singleton is double-checked under a lock. Tier provenance records requested-vs-served and marks the 72B claim asserted_not_proven.

note: Cloud disclosure was authorised by the process-global CloudConfig.enabled alone, so once an operator enabled cloud for one purpose every caller could send prompts and metadata off the host; a task now carries its own cloud_authorized plus an attributable authorized_by, and both must say yes. The check-call-charge sequence had no lock, so concurrent routes all saw the same headroom - it now reserves the estimate under an asyncio lock and reconciles the actual cost, with non-finite/negative provider costs refused instead of being added to spend. success=True with empty content, or with error populated, was recorded as a successful inference, and a prebuilt InferenceResult bypassed coercion entirely; success is now derived from what came back, for both shapes. Provider resolution normalised a config string into four candidate service names and handed the first object found the full task and CloudConfig including api_key - now an allowlist, an exact name, and an interface check. A TypeError raised INSIDE a provider was read as a signature mismatch and re-invoked the same task, so a provider that charged and then raised ran twice; the signature is inspected instead. Dual failure preserves both the local and cloud errors. The docstring's 'queue for local' described a queue that never existed (_local_queue_depth was never read or written) and the 30-day window is documented as not being a billing month.

note: Evidence destruction closed: corruption is now detected by reading the SQLite header BEFORE opening, because sqlite3.connect() on a non-database deletes the stale WAL during the failed open and the WAL holds the newest entries. The database and both sidecars are moved aside together, nothing is unlinked, and a quarantine that cannot complete refuses to start a fresh log over the old one (auditing goes unavailable rather than trading evidence for uptime). Corruption detection also broadened - 'malformed'/'corrupt' missed 'file is not a database', the most common message. record() returns '' when an event was NOT persisted and raises a CRITICAL degradation naming the loss, so a caller can tell a durable receipt from a lost event. Params are redacted through redact_structure rather than promised in a schema comment. A per-row hash chain with a genesis anchor and sequence commitment makes deletion, edit and re-insertion detectable, verify_chain() names the first break, and rows predating the chain are reported as unchained rather than counted as verified. Legacy databases are MIGRATED with ALTER TABLE, never recreated - verified against a copy of the live log: 2437 rows preserved. Full uuid instead of 48 bits, RLock around connect/execute/commit/heal/close, negative and absurd LIMIT bounded (a negative LIMIT means no limit in SQLite), and get_audit() double-checked under a lock.

note: Verified against current source. The exploitable scope is NARROWER than the finding states, and the reason matters. The v5 capability-claim path is protected: frontier_evidence_v5.validate_challenge_bundle enforces commit-then-reveal, a >=32-byte nonce with degenerate-value rejection, signer identity match, and binds the task spec to the reveal timestamp (a spec predating the reveal is refused). Commitments are therefore hiding at the time a candidate answers. The exposure is confined to frontier_gap._challenge_bytes' diagnostic-control fallback, sha256(f'diagnostic-control:{seed}'), which is fully derivable from the public seed. That mode is consumed only by verifier_curriculum for training, where brute-forcing yields nothing the grader does not already supply. Because the control nonce is domain-separated from a real challenge nonce, its commitments can never equal an evidence battery's, so a control battery cannot be substituted into a claim. GENUINE RESIDUAL GAP, not fixed here: battery_manifest computes 'held_out_challenge' and NOTHING reads it -- frontier_evidence_v5 never references it. The flag is advisory, so a future consumer could treat a control battery as evidence with no check firing. Deliberately not closed with a gate no caller invokes; that would be the same built-and-unwired pattern found three times this session. Closing it properly means threading the held-out property onto BatteryItem through every builder signature and enforcing it at the evidence boundary.

note: The liveness repair cancelled the stale loop and started a replacement in the same breath. cancel() only REQUESTS cancellation - the old coroutine runs on until its next await - so two _run_loop coroutines were alive at once, both mutating the same state object and committing over each other. A repair that produces two minds is worse than the stall it repairs. The restart is now chained to the cancelled task's done-callback, so exactly one loop exists at every instant, and if the old task will not die no replacement starts and that is recorded rather than masked by a second loop. Separately, the thread-context repair returned False immediately, so health read plain unhealthy while a recovery was already in flight with no receipt; _repair_pending is that receipt, a liveness_repair_scheduled event is emitted, and get_health_status reports it - 'recovering' and 'broken and unattended' are different operational states.

note: One defect from two sides. The listener acted on data.status=='success' alone and immediately unloaded the live Cortex - ~20GB of resident weights - with no check that anything had been produced; the event bus carries no publisher identity, so anything able to publish could evict her mind, and a malformed or duplicated event did it for free. The reload then used self.cortex_path captured in __init__, so the newly fused model was never bound: the lane unloaded and reloaded the SAME weights and every optimization run was a no-op costing a full reload. The ARTIFACT is now the authority - an event claiming success without a loadable fused_model on disk is not acted on, which needs no principal, cannot be forged by a publisher, and makes the pointless unload impossible. When the artifact exists the lane is rebound to it BEFORE the unload (rebinding after would reproduce the bug on the next load) and the stale personality adapter selected for the previous base model is dropped with the old weights.
title: Any optimizer success event can unload Cortex

note: Entries were self-hashed and previous-linked, and the first one linked to None. A chain that starts from nothing can be STARTED AGAIN from nothing, so anyone able to rewrite storage could replace or truncate the whole history, recompute every digest, and present a perfectly self-consistent ledger - internal consistency is not integrity when the attacker owns the file. A first entry now commits to EVIDENCE_CHAIN_GENESIS, and sign_chain_head/verify_chain_head put an HMAC (local key, O_EXCL mode 600, under state_root) over the head so a rebuilt chain cannot be presented as this host's. An absent signature is explicitly NOT valid, because a rewriter who drops the field would otherwise look identical to a host with no key. Pre-anchor history is accepted rather than discarded but is marked _unanchored_legacy_head, so an unanchored head can never pass as an anchored one.
title: Evidence index hash chain has no trusted signature or anchor

note: The Spatial Empathy watcher captured the person's screen whenever a global-workspace payload carried two matching strings. Reading unprompted now requires the same permission as speaking unprompted: _proactivity_suppressed_now() is checked BEFORE the capture and returns on a quiet window, so a quiet window means she is not observing either. note: The escape counter advances on every observed computation before any lane return, so a repair-lane stream can no longer hold an escape open; lane and escape floors compose by taking the higher. The ring records the EFFECTIVE temperature and the resolved lane, counts only non-decoupled lanes, and drops incomplete readings — DistressReading names the axes actually seen instead of substituting optimistic constants. Detection now requires the window to span min_window_span_s of real time, so a burst inside one turn is not a sustained state. Efficacy is the mean across the escape against the mean of the window before it, against a minimum effect, and the record states that the comparison is uncontrolled. Both fault records carry an escape id and the opening one carries the observations and calibration version; a failed registry write records a degradation and shows in status as fault_record_failures/audit_complete. Registry writes are collected under the lock and emitted after it. Non-finite temperature and non-numeric substrate values go through one validation boundary. Lane is a closed enum: an unrecognised label cannot buy the exploration floor. Thresholds are a versioned AntitrapCalibration whose basis says which numbers are not empirically calibrated.

note: Who decides is now recorded: _NON_NEGOTIABLE_VIOLATIONS is named as a constitutional floor, every consultation carries decided_by (will/constitutional_floor/will_unavailable), and a floor overriding an approving Will is counted and logged. The correction path reconsiders instead of injecting disagreement — the prompt asks whether they are right first and agreeing is a permitted outcome. Phi no longer gates pushback and is not handed to the generator as a selfhood signal. The failed-rewrite fallback no longer deletes regex matches from a finished answer; it states the boundary whole and counts the case. Capitulation requires the user to have applied pressure or a correction, so ordinary helpful replies are untouched. All quoted user and model text goes through core/security/prompt_fencing.fence, whose delimiters carry a per-call random id and whose content has tag-shaped sequences neutralised. Generators catch TimeoutError (not CancelledError) and reach the deterministic fallback. All three stages draw on one 12s _ResponseBudget. The substrate refusal quotes the measured coherence or says there is no reading. status() labels its counters process_local with since_unix.

note: Unmeasured axes are a Measurement with value=None carrying the reason, so an engine with no feature windows/scored canaries/paired metrics/value memories reports not_ready instead of scoring 0.0 on five risk axes and calling it stable; partial instrumentation caps the status at watch. Interventions are labelled recommendations with a named owner and enforced=False, and set_intervention_handler is the seam that closes the loop — the acknowledgement or the raised exception is recorded on the intervention. store_memory is idempotent by record id, so a repeat no longer re-penalises counterparts or appends a second row. Contradiction requires an explicit subject/predicate/value claim with canonical value comparison, so episodes sharing a domain are no longer contradictions. Both sides of a contradiction update are persisted. Pruning writes a tombstone that load applies, the log compacts to the retained set, and dangling contradiction ids are dropped. _append_jsonl appends instead of rewriting the whole file, on the governed write lane. load quarantines and counts unreadable rows instead of raising inside __init__. Metrics, confidences, utilities and canary scores must be finite. Overfit pairs train/hidden by run_id and reports paired=false when it cannot.

title: Load has no corruption or schema recovery

note: Each domain has its own _DomainView of objects and resources, objects expire on a TTL and confidence decays with time since last seen, so a hazard from one environment no longer scores risk in another. Risk declarations can only raise: a floor derived from the effectful tags and the authority tier is what kind='observe' and reversible=True cannot go under, and the observation discount requires both an observation kind and no effectful tag. Affordances report reversibility='unknown' except the observation-only default. The state id hashes positions, attributes, hazards, affordances, the map and the confidence, not just the observation id and object ids. Grounding confidence comes from the observation's confidence and the mean tracked-object confidence — not from how many objects were retained or whether a heuristic hazard was emitted — and reports its basis. Object ids use a natural key where one exists and declare identity='positional'/'cell' where they do not; a grid frame replaces its cells so a moved glyph leaves no ghost. Hazard matching is word-boundary, negation-aware and confined to condition fields, and 'low' is gone. save()/load() are implemented and called outside the caller's lock (an fsync under a lock is a lockdep failure); unreadable rows are skipped. _flat is depth- and cycle-bounded and pruning runs before the snapshot. Writing the cycle test found the same crash in canonical_json inside Observation.__post_init__, fixed there too.

note: An injectable belief_reader supplies prior beliefs, they are quoted into the belief-delta prompt as the only things that may be contradicted, and a contradiction claim naming something not in that list becomes a new position; with no reader the prompt states that no priors were retrieved and a change cannot be reported. Facts with no evidence are not recorded, and recorded ones carry the engagement plus an explicit unverified marker naming what is missing, with domain=reflection:<title> instead of the title as a knowledge domain. _as_bool handles JSON booleans written as strings, so 'false' is no longer a disagreement. The digest samples checkpoints evenly across the work with larger caps and reports its coverage in both the record and the prompt. substrate_delta catches TypeError/ValueError/OverflowError, drops non-finite values, and only emits a delta for channels present in BOTH snapshots; substrate_delta_report carries the uncontrolled-before-after caveat. Malformed nonempty output counts as an inference failure. All four phases share one 180s episode budget with per-call wait_for. Thread reconciliation puts every input thread in exactly one list, dropping invented and duplicate entries and parking whatever the model ignored. Confidence is parsed through a finite, clamped helper.

note: An unreadable safety_state.json became _empty_state(), clearing frozen_until, consecutive_failures and the promotion/observation lists — every one a restraint, so damaging the file ended a freeze early. _load_state now distinguishes ABSENT (a real fresh start) from DAMAGED: a file that exists and will not parse records a critical degradation and freezes for UNREADABLE_STATE_FREEZE_S with a reason naming the cause. note: _check_git_clean read only stdout, so a non-zero git exit with empty stdout (not a repository, index lock, permissions) reported the tree CLEAN — the check passed hardest when git was broken. returncode is now checked first and the failure names git rather than the tree. note: Verified against current source: is_dangerous_action now unions the caller's dangerous_whitelist with _DANGEROUS_NAME_PATTERNS and tokenizes camelCase/underscores first, so an unlisted destructive name (delete_all_records) still requires danger authorization.

note: Verified against current source: when ContextAssembler fails, prepared_messages is None and the function returns the caller's RAW prompt with no state or memory injected (see the return at the end of the messages branch). note: pool = valid if valid else cands collapsed 'nothing was checkable' and 'every candidate was provably wrong' into the same fallback, so a unanimously rejected set was clustered and shipped with the confidence of a merely-unverified answer — reintroducing downstream exactly the PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN conflation the enum exists to prevent. Pool preference is now certified, then not-rejected, then (only when the verifier rejected everything) the rejected set, with confidence multiplied by 0.25 and a warning in that case.

note: When no keyword matched, the classifier returned UTILITY_PERIPHERAL — a positive finding of 'peripheral utility' where there was no finding at all, so novel or newly-named subsystems inherited the most benign surface. note: Verified against current source: the lock/task instrumentation path now states 'Unavailable instrumentation is UNKNOWN risk, not zero risk' and no longer reports zero counts as an absence of findings.

note: Nine downstream systems updated in separate fail-open blocks, eight sharing one action string, so a mid-sequence failure left a partial update that nothing could name or join. Added a shared per-response update_id, a stage name on every record, a stage register, and a commit receipt (post_inference_receipt) naming which stages ran, plus one summary degradation when the sequence was partial. Rollback is explicitly NOT provided and the reasoning is in-source: these subsystems are not transactional stores. Fixed two latent defects found while testing: the nested hedonic/LoRA outer handler kept the generic string, and _record_inference_degradation did not accept extra so attaching context would have raised TypeError exactly when a stage failed.

note: Verified against current source: _proactivity_suppressed_now is documented FAILS CLOSED and returns True for both an absent orchestrator and a raising quiet-window lookup, each with a recorded warning degradation. note: _last_successful_generation_at is initialised to 0.0, has_generated_successfully reports whether any generation ever succeeded, and the age falls back to _constructed_wall_at instead of reporting zero.

note: Every block records its own omission; living_mind_context_receipt() reports included, omitted, dropped, and complete.

note: theory_of_mind and world_model are added as TRUST_LEARNED: fenced, labelled as observations, and stripped of chat control tokens and structure-forging headings.

note: _assemble_live_context bounds both the full and compact builders under one deadline, and the fallback gets the remainder rather than a fresh budget.
title: Compact context fallback is not bounded by the five-second timeout

note: _fit_prompt_to_window is the final authority at dispatch and is denominated in tokens via the live tokenizer; character limits upstream can no longer overflow the window.
title: Prompt limits are character counts rather than tokenizer budgets

note: The token fit runs on the shared dispatch path, so prebuilt payloads that skip the per-message compactor are still checked against the window.

note: AURA_CORTEX_CTX goes through model_registry.bounded_context_window; an unreachable registry falls back to the built-in default instead of an unbounded operator value.

note: _configured_token_bound clamps every token knob at both ends against _TOKEN_BOUND_HARD_CEILING.
title: Configured token bounds have no maximum

note: Both envelope branches go through _stakes_capped_tokens; the protected lane gets a ceiling derived from this turn's compute-profile floor and a recorded override receipt, not an exemption.
title: Protected capability contracts bypass viability token caps

note: Every advancing call is gated by advance_state and named in the receipt; the compact fallback no longer re-integrates the same axes. No rollback is claimed — these are integrators, not transactional stores.
title: Prompt assembly mutates multiple cognitive subsystems before generation succeeds

note: Every policy exit goes through _refuse_generation: typed kind, reason, optional retry-after, admission detail, delivered to the caller's context, the gate and the turn ledger.
title: Protected and deferred routes return bare None without a structured reason

note: Proof and desktop warmup refusals carry REFUSAL_PROOF_LANE with the lane and the contract flags that caused it; an AST test forbids a bare return None in generate().
title: Proof and desktop warmup refusal returns bare None

note: One request_deadline is created from timeout_val and every retry window is capped through _window_within.
title: Primary retries create fresh deadlines outside the unified request budget

note: APIAdapter and HealthRouter both take their window from the caller's remaining budget; an exhausted budget skips the cloud path instead of starting it.
title: Sequential cloud providers can add sixty seconds beyond local attempts

note: An expired deadline fails before dispatch with failed metadata instead of being clamped to a 0.5s window that wakes the lane.
title: Expired deadlines still receive a generation window

note: _abort_active_generation runs on the non-timeout path too, so a transport or runtime error no longer leaves the worker generating into a dropped request; failed metadata was already published there.
title: Non-timeout client failures have no local terminal envelope

note: Credit comes from the turn ledger's served verification grade, normalized against the top of the scale; an ungraded turn earns no entry. The length/format heuristic is gone.
title: Credit assignment rewards length and formatting instead of correctness

note: on_response_success carries verified, fallback and endpoint; a fallback answer is counted but does not raise integrity, and response_outcome_counts separates no-failures from no-data.

note: _post_inference_update returns before touching _last_successful_generation_at when the response is empty or whitespace.
title: Empty output updates the last-successful-generation timestamp

note: action_id is time.time_ns() plus a monotonic per-gate counter.
title: Second-resolution action identifiers collide across responses

note: _strip_silence suppresses only an exact silence token (with a short tail tolerance); any substantive response containing it is scrubbed and returned.
title: Silence is triggered by token occurrence rather than exact output

note: A repairable draft opens an obligation carrying the draft hash and reasons, the endpoint is marked provisional, and the turn ledger discharges it at mark_served with a changed/unchanged postcondition.
title: Repairable drafts are attributed to an endpoint before repair occurs

note: on_inference_abandoned restores the previous anchor and every refusal calls it, so a turn that never reached a provider does not advance temporal state.

note: contract_output_profile keeps the contract system builder when a long user message widens the input budget to standard.

note: _claim_lane_transition is a compare-and-set lease with expiry; all three paths clear a wedged warmup through _clear_wedged_cortex_warmup under one owner.

note: Cancelled loads are kept, await_abandoned_cortex_loads observes whether they stopped (asyncio.wait, not wait_for), and recovery refuses a warmup while a load is unproven.

note: The cooldown stamp is taken under a lock and rolled back when scheduling raises, so a failure to schedule no longer suppresses the next attempt.

note: warmup_attempted no longer defaults to True: a lane payload that omits it cannot satisfy the visible-conversation proof predicate.

note: ensure_foreground_ready rejects non-finite timeouts and clamps at both ends against _MAX_FOREGROUND_READY_WAIT_S.

note: The timeout path records a warmup overrun, not a stuck-process kill; both feed the same backoff but are counted and named separately.

note: The recovery attempt counter increments where a load is actually attempted, after the warmup-admission recheck.

note: An unreadable memory probe records a degradation and returns instead of falling through into unloading workers without verified pressure.

note: An origin must be an allowlisted label or start with one, and a leading background/internal/system word vetoes; a test proves no origin literal in the tree changes meaning.

note: A protected-lane promotion inferred from prompt text is budgeted to one shed per quiet window; an explicit protected_foreground_lane contract is unaffected.

note: Guest recognition no longer re-promotes a request that morphogenesis, resource stakes, a deep handoff or an explicit secondary tier already downgraded.

note: _requested_timeout_s and _requested_max_tokens validate and clamp before any deadline or budget state is built.

note: The system prompt travels as system_instruction through APIAdapter into Gemini's native field, and the result carries role_separation.
title: APIAdapter cloud fallback collapses system and user roles into one prompt string

note: Backoff is per provider, honours a provider-supplied Retry-After, never shortens an existing longer deadline, and is readable through cloud_backoff_state().
title: Cloud backoff is global and inferred from error text

note: cloud_call_error_types() resolution sits in its own try that records a degradation and falls back to the base recoverable tuple.
title: Dynamic cloud error-type resolution occurs outside the protected cloud try

note: _modulator_factor/_modulator_delta give all six modulators one finite, bounded, neutral-on-failure contract; a test names each call site.
title: Sequential internal modulators accept non-finite and unbounded outputs

note: The 'true embodied cognition' and 'raw felt perturbation' labels are gone; the mechanisms stay and the comments now say what the code does.
title: Somatic qualia and true embodiment claims are asserted from sampling perturbations

note: The background budget signal records itself as phi_surrogate vs phi_measured and states what it scales; the foreground lane was already excluded.
title: A surrogate Phi score controls compute under an integrated-information label

note: A sampling bias is honoured only when present in state.response_modifiers; a context-only bias is recorded in rejected_sampling_bias and dropped, and applied biases report their source.
title: Caller context is treated as advisory sampling authority

note: safe_to_self_report is read whenever a unity report exists, and a failed unity probe suppresses the self-report instead of leaving the default True.
title: A false safe-to-self-report signal does not suppress self-report content

note: seen_bias_values dedupes by value and both the temperature delta and the token factor are clamped cumulatively.
title: Sampling biases can be applied repeatedly from duplicate sources

note: GROUNDING_STAMP is a per-process nonce; the three producers stamp their evidence, and unstamped shapes are named once through unstamped_grounding_shapes().
title: Grounding system messages are trusted by caller-controlled markers

note: Section headers are matched at a line start only, so a header quoted inside user-derived text cannot promote what follows it into the protected excerpt.
title: Header text can make arbitrary content survive as a critical system excerpt

note: _manual_messages filters to dicts before reading them, so a malformed history item cannot raise outside the protected assembler try.
title: Manual message fallback is not robust to malformed history

note: The fallback preserves grounding system messages and maps the 'aura' role to assistant, so evidence and her own turns survive an assembler failure.
title: Rich message failure drops memory, goals, state, and tool-result grounding

note: The repair lane carries the turn's grounding alongside the dialogue tail; only the telemetry stack is dropped.
title: Primary repair messages deliberately remove system evidence needed for factual retries

note: skip_runtime_payload removes telemetry only; repair_retains_grounding records that the evidence travels in the repair messages.
title: Same-lane reliability retry explicitly skips the runtime payload

note: _prompt_state_snapshot deep-copies the whole state and records when it must fall back to the shallow-plus-cognition shape.
title: The derived prompt state is only shallow-copied outside cognition

note: Warmup deferrals are counted by cause with first/last timestamps and surfaced on the conversation status snapshot, without reintroducing CRITICAL escalation on a fail-closed subsystem.
title: RAM admission refusal is deliberately omitted from degradation records

note: initialization_receipt() records the boot mode and whether Cortex came up; _initialized is documented as setup-attempted and the health contract binds is_inference_ready.
title: Initialization can report complete with an unready Cortex

note: initialize() holds a lockdep-visible checked_async_lock singleflight; _initialize_locked owns client replacement and task creation.
title: Initialization has no singleflight or task ownership guard

note: _bounded_affect validates type, finiteness and range per axis, the public get_llm_params reader is tried before the private one, and defaulted axes are named in the context receipt.
title: Shared affect values use private APIs and an assumed percentage scale without validation

note: Only acknowledgement and resource_hold may answer before trust recognition; a mesh self-report defers to the governed path and records mesh_deferred_for_trust.
title: Mesh cognition returns before trust and routing policy is evaluated

note: A raised mesh path records a degradation and puts the reason in context['mesh_cognition_error'], distinct from an ordinary handled=False decline.
title: Mesh-path failure is only debug logged

note: _identity_prompt_cache_key digests every state section ContextAssembler reads; an unreadable state returns None, which means do not reuse.
title: Identity prompt cache key omits most prompt-relevant state

note: _release_worker_process proves exit before ownership is cleared and keeps a survivor in _surviving_workers; surviving_worker_count() reports unproven kills.
title: Worker cleanup clears ownership without proving process exit

note: think() hands the synchronous post-inference hooks to a thread via _schedule_post_inference_update, so nine subsystems no longer sit between the model finishing and the answer returning.
title: Synchronous post-inference hooks run inline on the async response path

note: Missing reward signals are unknown rather than 0.0, no reward evidence means no update, an external turn-ledger verdict outranks the internal hedonic score, and last_plasticity_reward() records the basis.
title: Synaptic learning uses internal affect as reward without an external outcome

note: The architecture excerpt is added to the volatile grounding blocks on the prebuilt path as well as to system_prompt, and the token fit at dispatch counts both.
title: Prompt contract, somatic, and architecture additions do not update prebuilt messages

note: required_phases comes from legacy_runtime_phase_specs, check_health derives status from phases/repository/stopped evidence with reasons, and is_ready requires phases.
title: A zero-phase engine reports a full healthy cognitive spectrum

note: commit_outcome is tracked through every exit from the commit loop, carried on the Thought as state_commit_outcome, and lowers confidence when durable state did not land.
title: Persistence failure still returns a successful 0.9-confidence thought

note: complete_foreground_turn fires after the commit loop and only on committed or test-isolated turns; an uncommitted foreground turn records a withheld-closure degradation.
title: Foreground closure is declared before state commit succeeds

note: _reapply_turn_changes restores only fields this turn changed against a pre-turn baseline, so a rebase keeps the concurrent writer's goals, initiatives, focus and modifiers.
title: Version-conflict retry overwrites concurrent cognitive state

note: _turn_response_message requires the assistant message to sit beyond the working-memory mark taken at cycle start, so an earlier turn's answer cannot be returned as this one's.
title: A prior assistant message can be returned as the current response

note: The three learning systems receive a reduced reward when the turn did not commit, instead of 1.0 for the existence of an assistant-shaped message.
title: Any assistant-shaped message receives maximum positive reward

note: _cycle_confidence derives from commit outcome and degraded-subsystem count, and the docstring states it is not a calibrated probability.
title: Successful phase output receives fixed confidence 0.9

note: The spine prior position is appended as a system message with type spine_prior_position instead of being spliced into the objective that becomes the user turn.
title: Hidden system corrections are persisted under the user role

note: The phase loop catches sqlite3.Error plus the full _COGNITIVE_ENGINE_RECOVERABLE_ERRORS tuple, so RuntimeError/AttributeError/TypeError/ValueError reach reactive recovery with a degradation record.
title: Common phase defects escape reactive recovery

note: The DEEP-to-FAST downshift forwards context=dict(context or {}) so desktop flags, live-mind evidence and scoped request metadata survive the retry.
title: Deep-mode recovery drops the entire context contract

note: The commit loop is bounded by what remains of cycle_deadline_at, with cycle_deadline_expired and commit_timeout as recorded outcomes.
title: The cognitive watchdog is not an end-to-end deadline

note: The motor fallback requires [EMBODIED CONTROL CONTRACT]; without it the turn returns an empty thought and records a refusal.
title: No-response action fallback emits an ungoverned keystroke command

note: Strict-answer recovery activates on the caller's answer_format kwarg or an explicit strict_answer_contract, never on an '<answer>' substring in the objective.
title: User-controlled strict-answer routing can send prompts to cloud fallback

note: The recovery verifies the <answer> envelope before claiming success and records a refusal when the envelope is absent.
title: Strict-answer recovery validates only nonempty output

note: The live-mind snapshot carries a per-process runtime stamp applied at its producer; an unstamped payload cannot bind generation controls.
title: Caller-provided live-mind dictionaries are self-attesting

note: required_subsystems_ok now gates _live_mind_controls_bound; the test that asserted bound=True beside ok=False asserts the corrected contract.
title: Control binding does not require required subsystems to be healthy

note: The partial rollback records what it restored and what it cannot (events, tools, rows, in-place mutations) through phase_rollback_receipt(), with a degradation naming it.
title: Phase rollback restores only a local object reference

note: A user-facing origin is never inherited from the orchestrator or the state repository; the refusal is logged once per (origin, source) and readable through refused_origin_inheritances().
title: Request origin can be inferred from shared mutable global state

note: _is_test_run refuses to classify a user-facing origin as a test run under ambient AURA_TESTING/AURA_AGI_MAX_TASKS, so a live turn keeps its state and its commit.
title: Ambient test environment variables change all request semantics

note: register_augmentor requires a callable get_augmentation and records refusals; augmentation output is bounded and neutralized, and runs on a thread under _AUGMENTATION_TIMEOUT_S.
title: Arbitrary augmentors can execute and inject context without governance

note: controls_bound is no longer re-derived from caller booleans; snapshot_ready and required_subsystems_ok fall back to context only for a stamped payload, so the structured floors cannot be minted by assertion.
title: Caller context can mint proof-bearing structured replies

note: _contract_safe flattens and bounds response_style_contract and mind_context_contract before they reach the system prompt, matching the inference gate's treatment of the same strings.
title: Context strings are appended directly to the system prompt

note: _log_safe_objective scrubs the objective before the log preview and refuses to print when scrubbing is unavailable; durable working memory keeps the person's real words.
title: Raw objectives are logged and durably stored without minimization

note: get_last_generation_metadata reads a per-task ContextVar slot and returns {} when this task never generated; the process-wide variant is separately named get_diagnostic_last_generation_metadata.
title: Generation metadata is read from an uncorrelated shared last-result slot

note: Both chat-route producers stamp each exchange and _desktop_history_messages_from_context drops unattested entries individually, so caller history cannot become an assistant turn.
title: Caller-provided history is promoted directly to chat roles

note: Structured floors carry pipeline_executed=False and measures_full_cognitive_cycle=False plus a reasoning line, so a passing floor cannot be read as a full-cycle result.
title: Proof and benchmark origins can return before the phase pipeline

note: _bounded_request_int validates and clamps caller max_tokens before the guarded router call instead of raising out of the turn.
title: Context parsing can fail before the generation error envelope

note: The shared orchestrator identity correction was removed; no pending-correction read or clear remains in the engine (the surviving comment records why both injections went).
title: Pending identity correction has no turn ownership

note: InferenceGate._fit_prompt_to_window is the final token-denominated budget for every assembled prompt on this path, trimming system scaffold largest-first and recording an over-window dispatch at error severity.
title: Grounding and history payloads have no aggregate input budget

note: surface_quality_gate_passed is None with a not_run status when the gate is disabled, and controls_bound comes from _live_mind_controls_bound rather than the caller's flag.
title: Structured-floor metadata fabricates bound controls and a passed gate

note: classify_target is bound before the strategy branch; a test drives force_strategy=DIRECT end to end where it previously raised UnboundLocalError.
title: Forced direct strategy reads an uninitialized variable

note: The reasoning layer rebuilds when the router object changes, under a checked_lock, and _raw_generate binds the router by default argument instead of closure capture.
title: Reasoning strategy state captures a stale router without synchronization

note: StateRepository.rollback takes an expected_version compare-and-swap precondition and refuses when the repository moved past it; both recovery call sites pass the version this turn derived.
title: Reactive recovery can roll back unrelated concurrent state

note: The reflex answer drops from confidence 1.0 to 0.5 and carries reflex_response/verified=False plus a reasoning line saying no verification ran.
title: An unverified reflex response is assigned certainty

note: _record_recovery_deferral writes the record both deferral replies claim, with a scrubbed objective preview, exposed through recovery_deferrals().
title: Recovery responses claim logging without recording a receipt

note: think_stream resolves origin, runs the structured safety floor before the router, binds live-mind controls, and records that surface-quality validation is not applicable to a token stream.
title: Streaming bypasses the governed cognitive path

note: record_interaction returns a receipt naming the sink or reporting that none took it, and records a degradation for a turn that reached no durable sink.
title: Interaction persistence can be dropped with no outcome

note: see() validates the payload type before any lookup and bounds/neutralizes the query through _contract_safe with a vision-specific limit.
title: Vision queries accept an unbounded untrusted prompt shape

note: The quick-reply reward derives from whether the reply completed rather than a fixed 0.8 for any nonempty generation.
title: Any nonempty quick reply receives a fixed positive learning reward

note: The prompt-shape floor drops from 0.99 to 0.7 with the reasoning stating that determinism is reproducibility, not correctness.
title: Prompt-shape fallback is assigned near-certain confidence

note: _emit_thought labels every published thought with audience, sensitivity and user_visible_speech, and bounds the content.
title: Raw thought content is broadcast on a global event topic

note: LIVE_MIND_CONTROL_POLICY names the policy as a hand-tuned heuristic with calibrated=False, travelling with the binding; the mechanism remains lesionable through influence_channels.
title: Live-mind sampling controls are uncalibrated hand-tuned heuristics

note: record_interaction classifies each turn's sensitivity through the PII scrubber and carries purpose plus classification on the receipt, giving retention and deletion a key without scrubbing her memory of the conversation.
title: Completed conversations are persisted without a data-governance boundary

note: Both forced-handoff sites copy kwargs and pop every explicitly-passed name; an AST test forbids splatting unfiltered kwargs at either.
title: Forced tool handoff passes system_prompt twice and raises before dispatch

note: LLMEndpoint.to_dict dumps with exclude={api_key, client} and reports has_api_key/has_client booleans; get_status builds on that dump.
title: Endpoint status serialization exposes API keys and arbitrary client objects

note: _authorized_tool_map bounds the map, filters names against the capability registry, and records dropped names; an unavailable registry is receipted rather than silent.
title: Public agentic routing accepts arbitrary tool maps without scoped execution authority

note: LLMEndpoint carries field validators bounding max_tokens to [1,131072], temperature to finite [0,2], and timeout.
title: Endpoint resource and sampling fields accept unsafe values

note: is_healthy transitions under self._lock and grants a single half-open probe lease with a TTL; peek_healthy is the observer-only reader.
title: Endpoint health transitions are unsynchronized and half-open without a probe lease

note: Cooldowns use time.monotonic() with an explicit cooldown_until map rather than backdated wall-clock last_success.
title: Circuit recovery uses wall-clock timestamps and synthetic success time

note: record_failure takes a structured error_kind; text sniffing is the fallback only and uses token-boundary matching.
title: Rate-limit identity is inferred from arbitrary error text

note: _redact_reason strips filesystem paths and token-like material and bounds the length before any health event is published.
title: Health events publish raw backend errors

note: Memory excerpts are bounded by _MEMORY_EXCERPT_COUNT/_MEMORY_EXCERPT_CHARS and labelled 'untrusted data, not instructions' in the prompt.
title: Recent memory is injected into model prompts without classification or bounds

note: Caller roles are normalized against _ALLOWED_ROLES (anything else becomes user) and the runtime system prompt is prepended ahead of caller system content.
title: Caller-provided chat roles are accepted as system authority

note: LocalLLMAdapter wraps the whole call in asyncio.timeout(endpoint.timeout) and returns a typed endpoint_timeout error.
title: The local adapter ignores its configured endpoint timeout

note: The static reflex performs no memory retrieval; the code carries the note that echoing stored memories turned model failure into a disclosure path.
title: Emergency reflex responses echo private memories directly to the user

note: The status heuristic states the main model is unavailable rather than certifying core functions, and the metadata carries fallback/degraded markers.
title: The static reflex claims healthy core functions and always returns success

note: _apply_core_persona requires the 'You are Aura' identity header; a bare mention of the name no longer suppresses the persona policy.
title: Any occurrence of Aura suppresses the core persona policy

note: Lane and capability claims are confined to routing comments about registered endpoints rather than asserted to the model as current facts.
title: The persona hard-codes model lanes and tool capabilities as current facts

note: _SAMPLING_BOUNDS plus _finite_or_none/_clamp_sampling reject NaN, infinity and out-of-range values before any override reaches a backend.
title: Substrate generation overrides are not range or finiteness checked

note: clear_rate_limits moves unhealthy endpoints to half-open instead of recording synthetic successes; they stay unhealthy until a real call succeeds.
title: clear_rate_limits can forge health and erase recovery state

note: register_endpoint treats an identical re-registration as an idempotent refresh and refuses a different identity without replace=True, with a receipt.
title: Endpoint registration silently overwrites routing identities

note: Fatal-pattern scanning is limited to text that plausibly IS an error payload, so an answer discussing OOM or segfaults no longer trips the breaker.
title: Fatal backend detection scans successful natural-language output

note: Adapter reboot is bounded by asyncio.wait_for(30s), a False return is recorded as declined, and only an unrefused reboot sets the cooldown.
title: Adapter reboot is reported triggered without timeout or outcome validation

note: Substrate generation runs off the loop through the bounded _try_substrate_primary path rather than calling generator.generate inline.
title: Synchronous substrate generation blocks the async router with no deadline

note: force_substrate is refused for non-evaluation origins with a PermissionError degradation instead of bypassing the confidence gate on a caller flag.
title: Caller flags can force substrate output past its confidence gate

note: Background classification no longer matches origin='system'; callers wanting background routing must pass is_background=True explicitly.
title: Caller-controlled origin can silently downgrade or suppress inference

note: The think wrapper is the module's never-fail boundary and is documented as such, returning a typed message rather than raising.
title: The never-fail claim has no outer exception boundary

note: _background_cache_key composes prompt, endpoint and generation settings, and caching is disabled for user-facing turns.
title: Background cache keys omit conversation, identity, route, and generation settings

note: Router statistics are mutated under self._stats_lock at every write site.
title: Router cache and statistics are mutated without synchronization

note: The supplied state is threaded into prepare_runtime_payload rather than discarded before routing.
title: The supplied cognitive state is discarded before deliberate-mode routing

note: guard_solver_request gates the deep lane and SECONDARY is refused without an explicit deep_handoff.
title: Caller booleans authorize access to the deep solver lane

note: _request_budget_s establishes one absolute wall-clock deadline for the whole cascade, bounded at 600s, and every attempt checks it.
title: Endpoint timeout values do not bound retries or the full cascade

note: Retries are bounded to one per endpoint inside the remaining budget, and error_kind plus _backend_failure_reason separate backend failures from ordinary ones.
title: Every ordinary failure is retried without idempotency or retryability classification

note: The retry guard requires attempt == 0 and more than 10s of remaining budget, so one empty response cannot spend three failure counts.
title: One empty-response request can count as three endpoint failures

note: Adapter success is cross-checked: a None payload under success=True is a contract violation, and a reported endpoint that differs from the selected one fails the call.
title: Success trusts adapter booleans and ignores returned model identity

note: Stream atomicity: once visible tokens reached the consumer, failover is refused and the stream terminates with an explicit interruption event.
title: Streaming failover concatenates partial outputs from multiple endpoints

note: Streaming applies a first-chunk budget from endpoint.timeout and a 60s inter-chunk budget, so a stalled provider fails over instead of hanging.
title: Streaming endpoints have no timeout or cancellation budget

note: Streaming successes record calls_by_tier, calls_by_endpoint and last_tier under the stats lock, matching non-streaming accounting.
title: Streaming success omits route and usage accounting

note: LLMEndpoint.egress is a validated local/cloud field and the failover chain filters cloud endpoints when egress is forbidden.
title: Default failover can send full private context to cloud-tier endpoints without an egress gate

note: _emergency_fallback keeps the raw provider error in logs and degradations only; the user-facing text carries no backend internals.
title: Ultimate fallback returns raw backend errors to the user

note: An agentic result carrying an error field raises rather than being accepted, so a failing client cannot be marked healthy or serve its error prose.
title: Agentic results containing an error are accepted as endpoint success

note: max_turns is clamped to [1,12] before delegation, with a non-numeric value falling back to 5.
title: Agentic max_turns is not validated before delegation

note: is_ready audits lane assignments, fails closed when the audit fails, skips the emergency tier, and uses peek_healthy so the probe cannot transition state.
title: Readiness treats never-probed endpoints as healthy and performs no live capability check

note: get_stats and get_status read through peek_healthy; only is_healthy transitions, and it is documented as the admission path.
title: Status and readiness reads mutate endpoint health

note: An empty request returns an explicit blocked-empty-generation message and logs the fault rather than a normal-looking reply.
title: An empty request returns a normal-looking response instead of a typed failure

note: get_llm_router constructs the singleton under _router_instance_lock.
title: Singleton initialization is not synchronized across threads

note: The attach now runs inside the block whose handler calls _finalize_fast_weights, and receipt.fast_weights_attach_attempted marks the model dirty before the first layer is touched. The vanilla-fallback guard, the runtime-integrity erase requirement, the cache-invalidation proof and the worker's requires_cache_clear all read the mutation fact rather than the completed attach, and the flag crosses the worker boundary in to_dict().
title: A partial fast-weight attach bypasses both cleanup and the dirty-model fallback guard

note: reason() is now a single-flight wrapper over _reason_episode holding a checked_lock for the whole lifecycle (pre-episode probe through post-episode invariant). A second caller gets LatentEngineBusyError rather than queueing; the worker handler turns that into a retryable refusal that needs no recycle. inspect.signature still reports the real parameters via __wrapped__.
title: The engine does not enforce single-flight access to its shared resident model

note: An attach returning zero wrapped layers now raises inside the lifecycle block instead of setting fast_weights_applied=True; the episode has no adapted function to attribute anything to.
title: fast_weights_applied is true even when attach wraps zero layers

note: _validate_token_ids checks every id as an exact non-negative int below the serving vocabulary (type(x) is int rejects bool) before anything is hashed or reaches the embedding lookup; the failing position is named. Applied to caller-supplied ids and to both tokenizer paths.
title: Raw token IDs are accepted without type, range, or vocabulary validation

note: _admit_input_length runs before the JSON commitment payload is built: it refuses a prompt past the model's own max_position_embeddings (tokenizer sentinels like 1e30 are rejected as windows) and refuses one the compute budget cannot pay a prefill for.
title: Input tokenization and commitment are unbounded before compute admission

note: _validated_verifier_result at the metered-verifier boundary rejects booleans and non-finite scores, so nothing NaN or infinite reaches branch ordering or the JSON receipt. The bytecode probe validates before it records the rounded score; the now-dead elif math.isfinite() branch is gone.
title: Non-finite verifier scores can enter branch events and selection

note: _require_finite_logits runs before every draw in _sample, and _logits_digest refuses to fingerprint a non-finite forward pass. NonFiniteLogitsError is a RuntimeError so it fails the episode through the ordinary phase handling, where the dirty-model guard now refuses a vanilla fallback.
title: Decode samples model logits without checking that they are finite

note: _newline_token_ids() derives the complete newline-token set from the serving vocabulary once and masks all of it at the cap, so no newline-family token remains reachable. If a newline still comes back, nothing else is admissible and the decode terminates as newline_discipline_exhausted rather than emitting it. The four-attempt budget is gone.
title: The advertised newline-run maximum is not actually enforced

note: An episode with no generated tokens is classified decode_incomplete:no_tokens_generated with a decode_produced_no_tokens flag, independent of what the tokenizer's EOS did.
title: Immediate EOS can produce an empty successful result

note: latent_opt_no_accepted_step is now keyed off optimizer.trace.accepted <= 0, and latent_opt_not_attempted is a separate flag for admission failure, so 'the verifier rejected everything' is distinguishable from 'the optimizer never ran'.
title: The no-accepted-step latent optimization flag tests attempts instead of accepted steps

note: _embed_cognitive_context carries each item's own position out with its vector, and the workspace uses the carried index instead of recomputing it from the row count. Duplicate source names no longer collide, and an item that encodes to nothing no longer shifts every later slot's text, length and hash onto its neighbour. The two-element seed form is refused outright.
title: Duplicate cognitive source names corrupt per-slot text provenance

note: Fast-weight compilation now selects slots on is_admitted_retrieval(item) — the typed memory_observation/evidence_observation roles whose contract carries a content commitment, retrieval receipt and epistemic-state digest verified in normalize_cognitive_context. The free-form source label no longer authorizes anything; _RETRIEVAL_SLOT_SOURCES is gone, and the slot receipt records admitted_retrieval.
title: Caller-controlled source labels authorize retrieval-to-weight compilation

note: is_exportable_provenance classifies each admitted item: only offline_reference and live_world_observation may be represented durably. _export_provenance_permits gates the consolidation-queue export and refuses an episode whose delta was seeded from episodic memory, governed tool output or the interlocutor's own turn, naming the class on the receipt. A mixed episode is refused wholesale because the delta is one object.
title: Retrieved private context can be encoded into exported adapter candidates without a data-policy gate

note: The admission estimate now computes decode_extension the same way _decode computes extension — contract grace on a contract task, sentence grace otherwise, honouring a caller-supplied decode_sentence_grace_tokens — so the up-to-48 sentence-grace passes are reserved instead of drawn from the fallback/canary/cleanup margin.
title: Admission reserves no layer budget for sentence-grace decoding

note: The six-second literal is replaced by wall_reserve_forwards=_FW_ERASE_PROBE_TOKENS+1 priced at the measured decode rate, floored by the timed pre-attach erase probe (same computation as the erase proof, so a cold engine has a real bound) and by the high-water mark of a completed cleanup. The check runs before the next forward is charged, and the probe width is one named quantity across affordability, charge and reserve.
title: A fixed six-second cleanup reserve cannot enforce the wall-clock safety obligation

note: Crossing the wall reserve at a sentence boundary emits wall_reserve_sentence_grace; crossing it mid-clause emits wall_reserve, which is no longer in reason()'s accepted set, the service's decode_incomplete set, or the live certificate's decode_complete set. A known fragment can no longer return ok=True.
title: A mid-sentence wall-reserve stop is accepted as a successful answer

note: Verified against current source: _enforce_fast_weight_verifier calls fast_weights.canary_erase() and sets disposition=rejected_verifier_unavailable on every fail-open branch — missing or non-finite pre_score, missing matched control, and probe_cost+safety_reserve over the remaining budget — and fast_weight_decode_active requires disposition==accepted_causal_improvement, so adaptation cannot serve. The post-adaptation probe is reserved before admission inside completion_reserve, and fast_weight_baseline_cost gates the attach.
title: Fast-weight task verification fails open when its reference or budget is missing

note: A cancel_check that raises is now treated as cancellation rather than as permission to continue, and the fault is receipted as cancel_check_callback_failed:<Type> so a broken channel is never mistaken for a person changing their mind.
title: Cancellation callback failures are interpreted as permission to continue

note: A failing progress callback is recorded once per episode in _callback_faults and surfaces as progress_callback_failed:<Type> on the receipt, so monitoring health is reported separately from model success.
title: Progress callback failure is silent in the episode receipt

note: The episode publishes its cancellation channel and cleanup reserve on the engine (safe under the new single-flight guard), and _decode_probe forwards both to _decode. The cancellation check runs before the memo lookup, so a cancelled caller gets the same answer whether or not the probe was cached.
title: Verifier probe decodes omit cancellation, progress, and cleanup wall reserve

note: _public_reason returns kind:ExceptionClass. No reason, receipt field or progress payload interpolates the exception message any more; the detail goes to record_degradation and the redacting log sink.
title: Raw exception messages are exposed through result reasons and progress callbacks

note: reason() is the structured-result boundary: the receipt is published once payload validation has passed, so a caller's contract violation still raises while runtime admission failures (encoding, commitment, pre-episode invariant) return LatentReasoningResult(ok=False) with the receipt. _close_armed_invariant closes a pre_episode that was armed and never paired.
title: Admission, encoding, and pre-episode invariant failures bypass the structured result contract

note: _public_text_or_receipt converts inside a guard and returns (text, converted); a tokenizer failure at the last step now yields a receipted public_text_conversion_failed result instead of losing the complete structured result and the progress stream's closing event.
title: Final tokenizer decoding occurs after all exception and cleanup handling

note: A stochastic episode derives its seed from its own episode_id and input_tokens_sha256 — stable for the same inputs, different across episodes — and _decode maintains a rolling sha256 over every (token, logprob) decision. Both land on the receipt as decode_sample_seed and decode_sample_trace_sha256, published in to_dict().
title: Stochastic decode receipts omit the random seed or sample trace commitment

note: _record_decode_discipline is the one finalization for both the latent and the vanilla-fallback path, carrying newline suppressions, the applied repetition penalty, the sample seed and the sample trace alongside the four fields the fallback already had.
title: Vanilla fallback decode omits decode-discipline receipt fields

note: MemoryError now has its own branch before the vanilla fallback: it releases the episode's probe cache and KV state tree, asks the device allocator to release freed buffers, flags fallback_refused_memory_exhaustion and fails with latent_memory_exhausted. The worker handler turns that flag into requires_worker_recycle rather than re-prefilling into a fresh cache under exhaustion.
title: Memory exhaustion is handled by allocating a fresh fallback cache

note: Finalization now only STAGES the candidate. _flush_consolidation_export runs in the episode's terminal path, after post_episode, and writes only when failure_reason is empty and params_unchanged is True; otherwise it flags fast_weight_candidate_withheld with the cause. The written evidence commits episode_ok, decode_termination, params_unchanged and the full honest_flags list atomically with the delta.
title: Consolidation candidates are exported before episode success and the final checkpoint invariant

note: The exported evidence now carries gain_status (verifier_confirmed vs unvalidated_optimization_candidate), the verifier identity, the fast_weight_verifier arbitration record, and the quality_verified/gain_established verdicts. A candidate backed only by proxy descent is labelled as such rather than leaving a falling loss trail to be read as task improvement.
title: Consolidation evidence contains proxy descent but no independently verified gain

note: EpisodeReceipt gains quality_verified, gain_established and verifier_identity, published in to_dict(). quality_verified requires a caller verifier, admitted branch selection and no budget skip; gain_established additionally requires the fast-weight verifier's accepted_causal_improvement. Downstream code can no longer read operational ok as a reasoning-gain claim.
title: Operational ok is not separated from verified reasoning gain

note: CortexConfig.branch_verifier_mode declares a caller verifier advisory (default) or required, validated. In required mode admission adds required_branch_verification_cost to minimum_admission, and an unaffordable branch verification raises instead of selecting on the ensemble's internal score.
