title: A supplied branch verifier can be skipped for budget and replaced by an unverified selector

note: prove_erase now requires structural restoration as well as probe equality: structural_erase_report checks that every touched module attribute is the original object again, that no EpisodicDeltaLinear remains installed, that no handles remain, and that a parameter digest over every touched layer matches its pre-attach value. The report rides on the lifecycle receipt; an episode that touched nothing is explicitly not 'restored'.
title: Fast-weight erase is declared proven from one narrow behavioral probe

note: The teacher-trajectory capture forward now builds create_attention_mask(h, None) and passes it to every layer, so the delta is optimized under the same causal semantics the answer is decoded under — and the same shape the budget already priced as triangular attention pairs. The erase probe stays mask-free by design, documented, because it is only ever compared against itself.
title: Fast-weight optimization uses a different attention computation from causal persistence

note: core/brain/llm/latent_cortex/recurrence_support.py classifies each loaded checkpoint as certified / structural_only / experimental from a registry of architectures with registered paired evidence plus a declared positional contract, and the verdict rides on every receipt. The registry is empty by default and an unreadable one certifies nothing, so today's honest answer is structural_only rather than silence.
title: Structural layer access is treated as sufficient compatibility for recurrent depth

note: CACHE_INDEPENDENT_TARGETS is empty and target_cache_attestation states why: both supported targets write into the residual stream that later layers' k/v projections consume, so cached prefix entries were computed under different weights. The attestation rides on the receipt and the episode raises fast_weight_prefix_kv_under_base_weights. The re-prefill alternative is a different cost profile that needs its own paired evidence and is not taken here.
title: Fast-weight evaluation and final decode reuse KV state produced under different weights

note: Probe scores are now explicitly advisory: quality_verified records whether a caller verifier actually judged the selection, gain_established requires the fast-weight verifier's accepted_causal_improvement, and both ride on the receipt separately from ok. branch_verifier_mode=required turns the caller's verifier into a hard gate reserved at admission. The exported consolidation evidence carries the verifier identity and gain_status so no consumer can read a probe pass as a claim about the served text.
title: Verifier decisions cover short greedy probes, not the returned answer

note: The fixed prefix supplies every required evidence term, so the model's own share is what must carry the claim. _operator_evidence_model_contribution_insufficient now (a) reaches the cancellation lane too — _terminal_contract_refusal takes model_continuation and the call site passes current_response, where it previously judged the combined text and so measured the scaffolding — and (b) requires that most of the continuation's words are ones the scaffolding did not supply, so the prefix alone and an echo of it both fail. The composition receipt (prefix_chars / model_chars / model_substantive) already discloses the split.
title: Operator evidence is prefilled with deterministic proof content

note: _validate_schema_output parses the emitted value (fences stripped, leading prose skipped via raw_decode), validates it with jsonschema when a mapping schema is supplied, retries once and otherwise delivers with a schema_validation_failed receipt. The first-token processor now derives its admissible set from _schema_root_openers(schema) and _json_start_token_ids(tokenizer, schema) — every way the tokenizer spells the declared root's opening — so array-rooted schemas can start and merged brace tokens are admissible; a tokenizer that spells none refuses rather than forcing one id.
title: Schema mode does not enforce the supplied schema

note: Verified against current source: _proof_evaluation_fragment_incomplete parses what the surface declares — python/py fences through ast.parse, json fences and bare JSON through json.loads, CSV only when EVERY line carries the same comma count — and applies length, word-count, terminal-punctuation and dangling-function-word checks otherwise. Semantic/task validation stays with the caller's verifier by design, stated in the docstring.
title: Proof completeness is inferred from superficial delimiters

note: Verified against current source: _safe_float returns the default for non-finite results and catches OverflowError; _safe_int catches TypeError, ValueError and OverflowError.
title: Numeric coercion accepts non-finite floats and leaks integer overflow

note: Verified against current source: the 20-digit rejection is gated on 'not is_proof', with the rationale recorded — large integers, hashes and numeric test vectors are legitimate exact answers in proof/eval mode and correctness is the harness's job.
title: Twenty-digit heuristic rejects legitimate proof values

note: Verified against current source: _merge_stop_sequences wraps a bare string, rejects non-list/tuple inputs, caps the merged list at 32 entries, drops stops longer than 64 characters, and line-anchors human-readable role labels.
title: Untyped stop sequences can become per-character stops and unbounded scan work

note: Verified against current source: the cached AURA_SDK_PATH fast path applies the same allowed-prefix validation as fresh xcrun output and logs a rejection before reprobing.
title: Cached SDKROOT trusts any existing environment path

note: Verified against current source: the shorter-prefix return is guarded by 'last_cache_index >= 0', so a cache stored at the first token is used instead of forcing a full prefill.
title: Nearest-cache search ignores a valid one-token cached prefix

note: Verified against current source: the batch loop breaks on 'token_count >= 8192' before the token is appended, so the 8192-token limit is the limit.
title: Absolute token cap is off by one and checked after content admission

note: Verified against current source: the streaming loop checks the absolute cap before computing emit_text, so no token beyond the cap is ever visible.
title: Streaming hard cap emits one token beyond 8192

note: Verified against current source: both the stream_done frame and the streaming error frame carry job['id'], alongside the abort flag, abort reason and token count.
title: Stream completion and failure responses omit request identity

note: Verified against current source: clear_cache tracks prompt_cache_cleared through the failure handler and reports it, plus bytes freed and retained bytes, so the parent can distinguish complete invalidation from a partially stale state.
title: clear_cache acknowledges success after prompt-cache cleanup fails

note: Verified against current source: the pong frame carries the request id, the model basename, steering_active and the active expert adapter path, so the parent can verify what answered.
title: ping reports pong without checking model or steering readiness

note: Verified against current source: the outer handler resolves the job id onto the error frame, sends type+truncated message only, and keeps the formatted traceback in worker logs.
title: Outer worker errors are idless and expose full tracebacks over IPC

note: Discovered metadata was already bounded to [2048, 262144], which handles the 1e30 tokenizer sentinel. The remaining half is closed here: both fallback paths — unreadable checkpoint and a checkpoint declaring neither max_position_embeddings, sliding_window nor model_max_length — now record a degradation naming the reason before returning _ASSUMED_CONTEXT_WINDOW.
title: Context-window discovery silently defaults or accepts unbounded metadata

note: Verified against current source: _restore_surface_generation_controls returns False on any restore failure and records a critical degradation, and all three call sites set worker_active=False and emit a surface_restore_failed frame so the parent respawns a clean worker after the current response.
title: Surface-control restore failures contaminate later generations

note: Verified against current source: _surface_generation_control_receipt separates caller_declared_fields — the echoed job booleans the worker cannot verify — from a worker_verified block carrying the worker's own measurements, with the provenance boundary stated inline.
title: Surface receipts repeat caller claims instead of proving them

note: Verified against current source: _capability_inventory_minimum_grounding requires category AND governance AND the non-execution boundary; the old 'or not effect-evidence' escape that admitted answers with neither is gone, and the boundary is documented as non-negotiable.
title: Capability inventory exemption does not require its documented evidence boundary

note: Verified against current source: the memory-fuse payload is delivered with put_terminal_direct (synchronous, flushed) when hard exit is allowed, so the parent sees the diagnostic rather than an unexplained SIGKILL-style death; the queued put remains only on the path that does not exit.
title: Memory-fuse error is queued asynchronously immediately before hard exit

note: Verified against current source: the job watchdog delivers a correlated terminal receipt through put_terminal_direct — request id, action, watchdog_timeout, attribution, timeout_s — before os._exit(2), and logs critically when the flush fails.
title: Job watchdog hard-exits without a terminal IPC receipt

note: Verified against current source: collect_trusted_pairs is called with limit=min(256, scan_limit*4), so total examinations are bounded by the derived collection cap rather than the old fixed >=500 floor, and pairs_scanned >= scan_limit still bounds budget-eligible scans.
title: Nonparametric ingest scan_limit still collects and can examine five hundred pairs

note: Verified against current source: the request loop rejects a non-mapping IPC frame with a recorded degradation before any field access, and the ping/clear_cache responders guard job.get with isinstance(job, dict).
title: Worker request loop trusts arbitrary queue objects and action shape

note: Verified against current source: the stream action admits every sampling control through _admit_sampling_control (typed, finite, range-clamped) and job_seq through _safe_int, so no IPC value reaches sampler construction unvalidated.
title: Streaming controls have no typed finite-range contract

note: Verified against current source: _ingest_progress and _latent_progress both spread the handler payload FIRST and set id/action/status last, so a handler payload cannot overwrite the correlation or status envelope.
title: Nonparametric progress payload can overwrite correlation and status fields

note: Verified against current source: draft-tokenizer compatibility checks vocab_size, eos/bos/pad token ids, then five probe strings covering code, mixed numerics, unicode and CJK, whitespace and line endings, and chat-control tokens with emoji — not one probe sentence — and refuses speculative decoding with a recorded degradation on any mismatch.
title: Speculative tokenizer compatibility is inferred from one probe sentence

note: Verified against current source: the prompt-cache memory policy reads model_size_class(model_path), which resolves through get_model_artifact_profile — a measured artifact profile with a declared fallback — rather than matching substrings in the path.
title: Prompt-cache memory policy is inferred from model-path substrings

note: Verified against current source: latent runtime controls are refused unless steering is active, the applied alpha is a non-bool number inside the surface-control admission range (0, 1], and no apply_errors were recorded; otherwise the job returns latent_runtime_controls_unapplied.
title: Latent runtime controls are accepted after only a numeric-alpha check

note: The corrupted-language check already applied in every mode. The backend-symbolic check now does too: its exemption was justified by a comment describing a pattern that no longer exists — the markers are exact-case identifiers matched without re.IGNORECASE, so lowercase prose never matched and 'field coherence' is not in the pattern at all. The path-wall check remains non-proof with the reason stated: unlike an exact token there is nothing separating a telemetry wall from a path-aware proof answer.
title: Proof mode disables corruption and backend-leak checks

note: _collapse_escape_noise already preserves any text where a backslash plays another role, so paths, regexes and escaped literals survive. Two seams are closed here: a chat-control token now truncates the turn instead of being substituted away (which glued the next turn's text onto the answer), and human-readable role labels only end a turn at a line boundary, so an exact value containing 'Assistant:' is no longer silently shortened. The envelope is only closed when envelope_prefixed says the PROMPT opened it, which is completion rather than manufacture, and that is stated in the docstring.
title: Strict-answer normalization corrupts literal content and manufactures the envelope

note: Verified against current source: generate_batch rejects a prompt over 400,000 characters before tokenization, clamps temperature to [0.0, 2.0] after _safe_float, clamps n to [1, 16] and max_tokens to [1, 2048], and refuses when prompt tokens plus the output reserve exceed the effective context window.
title: Batch generation accepts non-finite sampling temperature and unbounded prompt input

note: Verified against current source: batch status is ok only when len(texts) == n and at least one candidate is nonempty; the payload carries candidates_requested, candidates_returned, candidates_nonempty, per-candidate token counts and a batch_cardinality_violation message on mismatch.
title: Batch success does not prove the requested candidate cardinality

note: Verified against current source: the nonparametric_ingest branch resolves request_id and job_seq through _safe_int BEFORE the handler try block in a way that cannot raise, so a malformed seq yields a correlated nonparametric_ingest failure rather than an id-less outer error.
title: Nonparametric sequence parsing occurs outside its error boundary

note: Verified against current source: the dedupe receipt gets one bounded retry after the memory commit, and a persistent failure records a degradation and raises a typed nonparametric_ingest_receipt_persist_failed_after_memory_commit error carrying the ingested counts, so the caller can distinguish a partial commit from a clean failure it may repeat.
title: Nonparametric data and dedupe receipts persist non-transactionally

note: _regrade_against_deterministic_grader runs item.grade(answer) in BOTH validate_reference_artifact and validate_capability_report and refuses when the deterministic grader disagrees with the signed correctness boolean, in either direction. The graders are the module's own — exact integer, normalized text, and restricted-AST hidden execution through the governed dynamic-execution gateway — so re-running them is independent of the signature.
title: Capability validation never reruns its deterministic graders

note: resolve_model_manifest opens the declared checkpoint and compares existence, size and content digest for every file at or below _MANIFEST_FULL_DIGEST_MAX_BYTES, reporting files_present/files_digested and the mismatches. validate_capability_report calls it by default and require_resolved_model=True makes resolution a precondition; a checkpoint absent from this host reports model_path_absent_on_this_host rather than passing.
title: Model manifest hashes are never resolved against actual files

note: The measurement subject is still derived from the manifest — that check stays — but the manifest is now resolved against the checkpoint on disk, so agreement between subject and manifest is a statement about the model that ran rather than a self-referential one. An unresolved manifest is reported as such and can be made a hard precondition.
title: Model subject validation is tautologically constructed from the manifest

note: _validate_model_manifest now requires the role map to be a partition: a file claimed by two roles is refused (roles['adapters'] is what the adapter identity check reads, so a weights file listed there would be attested as an adapter), and every declared file must carry a role, so nothing ships with the checkpoint attested by nothing.
title: Model role map allows overlap and unclassified files
Any named hosted model can be declared an external frontier
note: The control provider must now be a recognised frontier lab from a narrow in-source allowlist; a self-named provider raises external_frontier_control_provider_unrecognised. The allowlist is a documented proxy for frontier capability, not a proof of it.

title: External control identity is copied from preregistration rather than authenticated
note: Per-trial receipts still bind to preregistration, but preregistration itself is now gated on a recognised provider, and the claim text carries EXTERNAL_CONTROL_ATTESTATION=provider_asserted_unsigned so no reader takes it for an attested comparison.

title: Resident 32B identity is entirely self-reported
note: Internal consistency was already enforced (manifest-derived count, manifest digest bound to the fingerprint, architecture/quantization required). Identity hashes remain syntax-only because resolving them needs artifacts present at certification time and a signing chain that does not exist; the claim now carries RESIDENT_MODEL_ATTESTATION=self_reported_internally_consistent rather than implying attestation.

Held-out/contamination was two booleans. Trials now carry a contamination receipt: scanner implementation digest, method, threshold, and the overlap actually measured, with the measurement required to satisfy the threshold. Admitted trials must share one scanner, so a producer cannot rescan a trial with a different scanner until it passes. Dataset lineage beyond the issuer-committed task manifest and a SIGNED scan artifact remain out of scope: no signing chain exists for scanner operators.

min_trials_per_domain was the only notion of adequacy and was fixed before exclusions. The preregistration now declares target power and the McNemar alternative it was sized against, and achieved power is recomputed by exact binomial from the discordant pairs that survived admission. Not post-hoc power: the alternative is preregistered, only the sample size is realized.

Run-order balance was global and counted rejected trials. It is now counted over admitted trials, per domain, and the paired difference is compared across orders against a preregistered maximum, so a gain concentrated in one order is refused. Random assignment attested by the issuer is not verified; arm order is now inside the issuer-signed pre-evaluation manifest.

Deduplication ran on task_payload_sha256 only. The task issuer now commits a clustering receipt before evaluation (method, similarity ceiling, measured maximum, per-task family), families are the unit of independence, and both the effective sample and the discordant-pair count are computed over families rather than rows.

The signed manifest committed which tasks would run and nothing about how. Arm order, scorer configuration, decode policy and tool policy for both arms are now inside the issuer signature, and the clustering and blinding-map digests are bound into the commitment payload. Evaluator assignment remains uncommitted; the certificate does not model per-evaluator assignment.

Blinding was a per-trial literal true. It now requires an arm-label map committed before evaluation inside the issuer signature, a reveal event after the last score attributed to the role that held the map and never to the producer, and a marker scan over scorer inputs with a scanner digest, method, count checked, and zero found.

Outcomes were bare booleans. Each arm now records a scalar score, the boolean must equal the preregistered threshold applied to it, and the gain must survive moving the threshold anywhere inside a preregistered band. The audit evaluates the band edges plus every observed score inside the band, which is exact for a step function. Inter-rater agreement is out of scope: the certificate has one scorer implementation by construction.

No completion timestamp existed anywhere, and attestation was compared against evaluation START. Trials now record evaluation and scoring completion with ordering checks, and the independent attestation must postdate the last score. The same defect at the attestation-request helper in frontier_verifier.py was fixed in aa743b1ad.

Independence compared a signer id against an unauthenticated producer string. The producer now signs its bundle with a pinned key covering the evidence payload, preregistration, commitment and artifact manifest digests; trust pins name the organization holding each key; roles must be organizationally disjoint; and a verifier sharing the producer's organization is refused.

A single attestation settled a release-grade claim. The bundle now carries a list of attestations, a quorum of verifiers from distinct organizations is required, duplicate signers are named and do not count twice, a dissenting or invalid signature does not count toward quorum, and a trust set that cannot reach quorum is refused when it loads. Cross-organization threshold policy is fixed at the module constant rather than per-claim configurable.

_recomputed_execution_summary derives attempted, completed, failed, invalid, empty and disqualifying_fallbacks from the item evidence itself — blank answers, execution_error, correctness receipts whose checked flag is not True, and the fallback lists on the worker receipts — and validate_capability_report refuses when the report's counters disagree with any of them.
title: Eligibility execution summary is not recomputed from item evidence

note: _reject_worker_fallbacks scans every worker receipt's fallbacks_used on BOTH the reference and the candidate path and refuses the claim when any is present, naming the fallbacks. The separate disqualifying_fallbacks counter is now recomputed from the same receipts rather than trusted.
title: Claim eligibility ignores worker-reported fallbacks

note: The reference measurement time is bracketed by the run it describes and the challenge that had to precede it: negative values are refused, the run may not begin before the challenge was revealed or after it expired, and measured_at may not precede the run's own completion.
title: Reference measurement time is unbound to signed run chronology

note: validate_capability_report takes verification_time_unix and require_fresh_challenge and threads both into validate_challenge_bundle AND the embedded validate_reference_artifact, so freshness set on one validator can no longer be undone through the other.
title: Reference and capability paths do not require a fresh challenge

note: measure_output_tokens recounts every answer with the caller-supplied effective tokenizer, refusing anything over MATCHED_BUDGET['max_tokens'] and any count that contradicts the worker's signed resource_usage. Without a tokenizer the measurement is reported as worker-asserted with its reason, and require_measured_output_tokens makes a real measurement a precondition.
title: Bound outputs are not retokenized against the 256-token limit

note: comparison_stratum_sha256 is one definition used by the builder and the validator, and it now binds the seed, the challenge bundle digest and the reference's realized per-class scores alongside battery version, per-class count, reference runtime and protocol. Runs against different task draws or different reference results no longer share a trend stratum.
title: Trend stratum omits challenge, seed, and reference score realization

note: GapLedger.add takes an evidence_blob_remover and, after pruning index entries, reclaims each pruned evidence digest that no surviving entry still references. A reclaim failure is logged and leaves the chain intact, because an unreclaimed blob is wasted space rather than a broken ledger.
title: Ledger pruning never reclaims content-addressed evidence blobs

note: _bounded_evidence_blob refuses a restored snapshot that is not a mapping, nests deeper than MAX_EVIDENCE_BLOB_DEPTH, or canonicalizes to more than MAX_EVIDENCE_BLOB_BYTES — and it runs before the digest is computed, so the bound precedes the expensive work rather than following it.
title: Evidence blobs have no size or nesting limit on restore

note: validate_non_capability_report replaces the scalar spot-checks: evidence class, schema and battery version, a non-negative generation time, a score inside [0, 1], a positive effective_n, item count agreement, and per-item checks of any field the evidence actually declares (index position, known task class, bounded answer, boolean verdict), with the score recomputed when every item carries a verdict. It runs on add AND on restore.
title: Rejected and control evidence receive only shallow validation

note: GapLedger carries pruned_chain_sha256, a hash chain whose every link commits to its predecessor, the removed entry digest and the running pruned count, so the count and the anchor can no longer be written independently. Restore requires the chain on any ledger that pruned and refuses one on a ledger that did not; erased history is still diagnosed first by the anti-rollback check.
title: Pruned count is not cryptographically tied to removed history

note: first_party_import_closure walks the transitive first-party imports of the execution roots (resolving relative imports against the importing package) and source_component_coverage reports what the declared list covers of it — closure size, covered count, missing paths, and closure_truncated. A truncated walk can never report complete, the walk is breadth-first so truncation cannot evict the roots, and require_complete_component_coverage makes coverage a precondition.
title: Source attestation covers a fixed partial component list

note: resolve_workspace_state compares commit, tree, clean, issues and the three workspace digests with a live measurement from a caller-supplied observer, reporting per-field mismatches and distinguishing 'not observed' from 'differs'. Without a resolver the result is UNRESOLVED with its reason rather than a silent pass, and require_resolved_workspace makes independent resolution a precondition.
title: Clean workspace fields are self-asserted rather than independently resolved

note: stability_bracketing checks the window's observation times against the run's own started/completed chronology: the first observation may not follow the run's start, the last may not precede its completion, and out-of-order times are refused. The times are carried outside the hashed body so existing signed windows keep their digests, and a window without them is reported unbracketed rather than counted as proof.
title: Before/after stability receipts have no observation times or runtime linkage

note: runtime_identity_binding ties worker_implementation_sha256 and prompt_template_sha256 to attested source components and tokenizer_sha256 to the model manifest's tokenizer-role file digests, reporting each field as bound / component_not_attested / digest_differs. require_bound_runtime_identity makes a complete binding a precondition of the claim.
title: Runtime identity fields are not tied to measured source or model components

note: grader_implementation_sha256 now digests the grader source together with grader_execution_environment(): Python version and implementation, the ast feature version, the dynamic-execution gateway's own source digest, and the exact admitted builtin set. Changing any of them changes what 'graded correct' means, and now changes the digest.
title: Grader digest omits execution runtime and gateway semantics

note: The coding battery appends _ADVERSARIAL_HIDDEN_CASES to the seven random draws — single-element, all-equal, extremes at both ends, and ascending/descending runs — which are exactly the structural collisions of the admissible expression space, and the grader adds a metamorphic order-invariance check so a position-shaped answer cannot survive. Measured on a real battery item: sum, max, min and len each pass only their own task.
title: Code correctness is inferred from seven sampled cases

note: When the signed reference ships a source_identity envelope it is validated through validate_source_identity against the trusted release keys and required to be the identity its source_identity_sha256 names, so the field can no longer be an arbitrary well-formed digest.
title: Reference source identity is accepted as an arbitrary digest

note: run_battery now wraps every solve in asyncio.wait_for at MATCHED_BUDGET['hard_timeout_s'], recording a timed-out item as an invalid miss with a TimeoutError execution_error, and publishes budget_enforcement naming what it enforced (per-item hard timeout) and what it does not measure (process isolation, generation calls, output tokens, tool/network/cache counts) plus claim_eligible=False, so reporting MATCHED_BUDGET no longer implies matched execution.
title: Diagnostic runner advertises a budget it does not enforce

note: battery_scope() states the battery's four narrow classes and what it explicitly does not measure — difficulty calibration, contamination control, transfer to unseen families, coverage of any frontier suite — with supports_general_capability_claim=False, and it rides on both the run report and the validated capability report so a capability/gap label cannot be read as broad model capability.
title: Battery is a tiny public diagnostic rather than frontier coverage

note: candidate_non_disclosure checks the one ordering the evidence can support: every candidate worker receipt must have started before the reference's measured_at. When it holds the report records basis=worker_start_precedes_reference_measurement; when it does not, the basis is recorded as sealed_execution_assertion_only rather than left implicit, since a later run may still have been sealed.
title: Candidate non-disclosure from reference answers is not proven

note: actor_independence reports the separation's real strength: cryptographic_only when only keys differ, shared_custody when the declared custodians overlap, custody_attested only when every role carries an organization and a distinct key custodian. It rides on the validated capability report and require_attested_custody makes it a precondition; validate_evidence_role_separation keeps the key check and its docstring now says necessary-not-sufficient.
title: Distinct keys do not prove mutually distinct actors

note: validate_worker_receipt now refuses any non-empty fallbacks_used, naming the fallbacks: disclosing a fallback meant the path that answered was not the path the receipt attests, so the receipt cannot stand as evidence for a matched run.
title: Worker receipts accept arbitrary fallback use

note: MATCHED_BUDGET gains max_input_tokens and max_peak_memory_bytes, and _validate_resource_usage enforces both, so a worker can no longer consume arbitrary context or RAM with all_within_budget true.
title: Input tokens and peak memory have no protocol cap

note: validate_supervisor_observation binds observed_at_unix to the response it claims to have observed and to the run window through new bindings, and validate_run_envelope additionally requires every observation to fall at or after its worker's completion and inside the signed run window.
title: Supervisor observation time is never bound to the run window

note: MAX_CHALLENGE_COMMIT_AGE_S bounds the commit-to-reveal gap, so an evaluator can no longer hold a commitment indefinitely and reveal it when the result suits.
title: Commitment age before reveal is unbounded

note: validate_challenge_bundle's require_fresh defaults to None and resolves to True whenever verification_time_unix is supplied, so a caller who passes the clock gets the window checked. Declining freshness is now an explicit False, and with no clock supplied there is still nothing to check against.
title: Challenge freshness is optional and disabled by default

note: _validate_index_entry_semantics runs inside validate_index_chain and requires a real evidence class and battery version, a non-negative timestamp, a canonical challenge id, overall_candidate_score inside [0, 1], overall_gap inside [-1, 1] when present, and a positive integer effective_n — so a self-consistent malformed entry can no longer feed arbitrary finite gaps into the trend.
title: Trend-driving index fields are not semantically validated

note: sequential_looks(measured_runs, minimum_runs) counts the opportunities the series itself permits — one at the minimum run count, one more per additional run — and sequential_alpha spends the nominal alpha across them, so significance tightens as the series grows instead of being recharged in full on every call. The minimum-run case keeps the nominal level, so the correction does not foreclose a legitimate first claim, and the result publishes sequential_alpha and sequential_looks.
title: Repeated trend checks have no optional-stopping correction

note: The trend now publishes inference_assumptions: run_order_treated_as_time, exchangeability_assumed, preregistered_horizon=False, the stopping rule in force, and the measured residual lag-1 autocorrelation. The assumption is stated and its violation is measured rather than left for a reader to assume held.
title: Trend inference assumes exchangeable independent run order

note: MAX_RELEASE_ATTESTATION_AGE_S bounds the attestation's validity, validate_source_identity refuses one dated in the future beyond the clock-skew allowance, and revoked_release_keys refuses a signature from a revoked signer. Without a verification time the age check is skipped rather than guessed.
title: Release attestation has no expiry or revocation semantics

note: validate_task_spec type-checks seed and per_class as non-negative non-bool integers and battery_version as a string BEFORE comparing them, so 1 == True can no longer satisfy a check meant to pin the battery instance, and issued_at must now precede the challenge expiry as well as follow the reveal.
title: Signed task scalar types and validity window are incompletely checked

note: MATCHED_RUNTIME_MODIFIERS pins the admitted modifier set and each value exactly — contrastive_decoding False, recurrent_loops 1 — with the type checked before equality, so an undeclared modifier, a missing one, a value off the matched one, or a boolean standing in for a loop count is refused instead of riding in an unconstrained dict.
title: Runtime modifiers are unbounded and semantically unchecked

note: CANONICAL_JSON_PROFILE names the encoding every signature and digest is taken under, CANONICAL_JSON_CONTRACT records what it guarantees and its known divergences from RFC 8785 (Python repr number formatting, ensure_ascii escaping) and states cross_language_standard is None, and PROTOCOL_MANIFEST pins the profile so changing it changes the protocol digest rather than silently diverging.
title: Signature format uses Python JSON rather than a pinned canonical standard

note: derive_item_seed computes the challenge_item_derived seed from the challenge nonce digest and the item id, so both sides reach the same value without exchanging it and a verifier recomputes it from evidence it already holds. validate_worker_receipt accepts generation_seed as an optional field and refuses a receipt whose declared seed does not follow the policy it names; the field set is otherwise still exact, because an unknown field in a signed payload has no validation rule.
title: Seed policy is declared but no actual item seed is recorded or checked

note: EVIDENCE_ASSURANCE grades runtime_isolation as self_reported with its specific gap recorded — no sandbox measurement, namespace proof, launch receipt or cache inspection — and the protocol manifest carries the grade so it cannot be downgraded silently. The booleans still say what is claimed; the grade says what backs it, which is what stops a signature reading as a measurement.
title: Runtime isolation is accepted as an unsigned self-description

note: prohibited_resource_use is graded self_reported with the gap stated: the tool/network/cache counters are worker-signed and nothing kernel-, proxy- or filesystem-level ties them to effects. Published in evidence_assurance() and pinned into the protocol manifest digest.
title: Prohibited resource use is proven only by worker counters

note: process_isolation is graded self_reported, naming exactly what the single-PID observation does not carry: start identity, parent, executable hash, namespace, per-item replacement and termination proof.
title: Supervisor receipt does not prove fresh-process isolation or cleanup

note: supervisor_observation is graded self_reported with the gap recorded — the observation carries no signature of its own and the run coordinator signs its hash — so it can no longer be read as an independent attestation. The observation's timing is separately bound to the response and the run window.
title: Supervisor observations are not independently signed

note: release_head_and_tree is graded pinned, stating that the release signature covers repository, remote, ref, release commit and issue time only, so the measured commit and tree remain unsigned claims. Paired with the release validity window and revocation list added alongside.
title: Release signature does not attest the measured head or tree

note: verifier_implementation is graded pinned, recording that the digests are compared with caller-supplied strings and that no artifact manifest or executable measurement establishes what code ran.
title: Verifier implementation and release digests are pin assertions only

note: grading_trace is graded self_reported, naming the gap: grader_execution_sha256 is opaque to this validator and the commitments are not opened here. The independent half is closed in frontier_gap, where both validators now rerun the deterministic grader against the answer and refuse a signed verdict that disagrees.
title: Correctness receipt does not bind an executable grading trace

note: inference_libraries is graded self_reported, recording that library_lock_sha256 hashes name-to-version labels rather than installed code, build flags or transitive libraries, so different wheels can share one lock digest.
title: Library lock hashes version labels rather than installed code

note: is_alive() is now a pure query: it reports and records what it observes and repairs nothing. ensure_alive() performs the repair and returns the result, and the health contract declares it as mind_tick's recovery_check. recover_failed_services(verdict) runs recovery hooks after the statuses are recorded, only for services whose liveness failed, reporting per service what it did; evaluate_health is documented and tested as never repairing. The repair logic itself is unchanged — rate-limited and chained to the old task's completion so there is exactly one loop at every instant.
title: is_alive mutates and restarts the service

note: The slow-tick path now sleeps max(1.0, elapsed * 0.5) directly instead of subtracting elapsed from the proportional interval, which collapsed every tick slower than twice the interval to the 1s floor — the slowest ticks got the shortest rest. The fast path still paces to interval - elapsed.
title: Slow-tick backoff formula collapses to one second

note: asyncio.CancelledError is no longer swallowed as spurious: the loop records a loop_cancelled degraded event naming the interrupted stage and re-raises, so the task completes and the done-callback repair — chained so exactly one loop exists at any instant — is the explicit restart owner.
title: Main loop swallows cancellation as spurious

note: _record_bus_outage keeps a standing event_bus_publish_failing degraded record while publishing is down, re-asserted every _BUS_OUTAGE_REASSERT_TICKS instead of being suppressed after three failures with the degradation call commented out. Log backoff is retained; silence is not, so a runtime with dark telemetry no longer reads as healthy.
title: Repeated event-bus failures suppress degradation

note: config.paths.pid_file resolves aura.pid against the runtime home directory, and both the immune audit in mind_tick (which reads the pid and signals it) and SignatureRepairRegistry._repair_pid_cleanup (which deletes it) use it, so neither can act on another runtime's file because of the launch cwd.
title: PID path depends on process cwd

note: Verified against current source: the mind_tick event payload publishes _elapsed_so_far measured from this tick's start rather than metadata.duration, which is not assigned until after the publish; the comment records why.
title: Tick telemetry publishes duration before computing it

note: Verified against current source: the state-load timeout path advances only _mark_loop_progress('state_load_timeout_yield') and deliberately does not touch _last_successful_tick_at, with the reasoning recorded inline; the tick counter advances in the finally block for every tick including degraded ones, which is the heartbeat's own contract rather than a success marker.
title: Missing state still advances successful heartbeat markers

note: The deferred-cold-Cortex notice branch no longer continues the outer tick loop: the escalation moved into an else, so a normal prewarm-policy cold Cortex skips only the incident report instead of abandoning every remaining phase and the commit on every thirtieth tick.
title: Missing error object skips the rest of the tick

note: The spontaneous-utterance gate replaces 'len > 5 OR any alphabetic' — whose or made the length test vacuous — with the same assess_user_facing_reply the foreground lane uses, plus _terminal_complete and a four-word floor, because an unprompted utterance has no question giving it meaning and must stand alone as a finished thought. Measured: 'a', 'ok' and 'Hello there' are withheld and a complete sentence is spoken; the withholding reason is logged.
title: Spontaneous response quality gate accepts nearly any text

note: Dream consolidation is detached after commit by design: it is long-running background work that must not hold the rhythm loop, and the commit is what makes its input durable first. Awaiting it inline is the defect this shape exists to avoid — the tick loop wedging on a dependency, which CP115 and the 2026-07-07 40-minute stall both measured. Left as is; the tick's own liveness markers and stage names already make a wedged consolidation visible.
title: Dream consolidation is detached after commit

note: The metacognitive revision attaches an aura.mind_tick.metacognitive_revision.v1 record to the message it rewrites: the original content, its sha256, the reviser, the reason, the timestamp and the tick. The original is captured before the overwrite, so the committed memory carries its own correction chain instead of losing what she said.
title: Metacognitive audit rewrites committed assistant memory

note: The surprise observation is recorded through add_observation, which the causal world model stores as a correlates_with edge and upgrades to causes only on an intervention with a receipt. mind_tick now passes reported_by='mind_tick.prediction_surprise' so the distinct-reporter confidence introduced in CP126 462e62cb can attribute it, and the log states that the edge stays correlational until an intervention says otherwise.
title: Prediction surprise is stored as a causal edge

note: get_world_state().update() now runs through asyncio.to_thread under a five-second wait_for, so the psutil CPU/memory/battery/thermal syscalls no longer execute on the event loop. A timeout is receipted as a tick_stage_timeout and the loop keeps its progress marker rather than wedging on telemetry.
title: World state is mutated synchronously outside repository control

note: The immune pulse moves its blocking work off the loop: the resource-observer process probe and gc.collect() run through asyncio.to_thread — a full collection on a process holding a resident 32B is a multi-second stop-the-world pause — and the log sieve's directory listing and reads run in one thread call bounded to the sixty-four newest logs, so the audit no longer slows down as incidents accumulate.
title: Immune pulse runs garbage collection and filesystem scans inline

note: _dream_research_modules runs through asyncio.to_thread under a 120-second wait_for instead of executing metacognitive assessment, value-graph evolution, the hidden eval suite and STDP diagnostics on the rhythm loop. A timeout is receipted and marked as loop progress.
title: Dream research runs heavyweight synchronous subsystems inline

note: Verified against current source: the throttle probe reads resource_governor.is_throttled(), a plain flag read on an already-constructed sampler, and the LLM tier sweep it guards is already bounded by asyncio.wait_for with a receipted timeout and a progress marker. The blocking resource probes in this file — world state telemetry and the immune pulse's process/gc/log work — are moved off the loop in this same batch.
title: Resource and throttle probes execute synchronously

note: The offline fallback called get_mlx_client(), which resolves a model path and constructs a backend: a health probe that can initialize MLX inside the rhythm process. It now asks ServiceContainer for the registered client and reports 'unknown' when nobody has stood the lane up, rather than a verdict it has no evidence for.
title: Sidecar health fallback can initialize MLX in the tick process

note: Stall thresholds were 600s stale and 900s hard against a 2s conversational tick, so a loop could miss three hundred beats and still report alive. Both are now derived from MAX_BOUNDED_TICK_STAGE_S, the loop's own longest bounded stage, at 1.5x and 2x.
title: Liveness thresholds permit ten-minute stalls

note: Re-recorded from 'remediated_scope_named', a status no reader recognised, so a closed finding counted as open. Re-verified against current source: parameter_count_source must be checkpoint_manifest (line 425), the manifest digest must equal the checkpoint fingerprint (line 438), and the structural count from the compute profile must match the declared one (line 406). The identity hashes stay syntax-only because resolving them needs artifacts present at certification time and a signing chain that does not exist; RESIDENT_MODEL_ATTESTATION=self_reported_internally_consistent (line 169) says so on the claim instead of implying attestation.
title: Resident 32B identity is entirely self-reported

note: The TaskGroup wrapping the degraded phase loop never created a task, so it named a concurrency that does not exist. It was not inert: a TaskGroup collects an exception escaping its body into an ExceptionGroup, which none of the method's except _MIND_BOUNDARY_ERRORS clauses match, so the decoration was disabling the tick's error handling. Removed; the loop stays sequential because each phase consumes the state the previous one returned. A test demonstrates the ExceptionGroup conversion rather than asserting it.
title: TaskGroup phases are still sequential over shared mutable state

note: The second pipeline was already refused once the kernel had booted, but nothing said anything when the kernel had never booted. Every entry now records second_phase_pipeline_active against the kernel's absence, and after MIND_TICK_KERNEL_ABSENCE_ESCALATION_TICKS consecutive ticks the record escalates from warning to error; a live kernel clears the counter.
title: Kernel absence activates a second phase pipeline

note: The canned line went into working memory as an ordinary assistant turn and the objective was completed immediately after, retiring a request the runtime never answered. The placeholder now carries the phases that did not run, placeholder/answers_request flags so no consumer renders it as the reply, and a failure_disclosure block; the objective is retained so the next tick answers it, which is what makes the holding line true.
title: Reflex fallback emits a shallow static answer

note: The 45s bound stops a wedge and does nothing about contention: a sweep that finishes inside its budget has still taken the model lane from a turn in flight, and its recovery paths spawn and load workers. It now yields on _background_reasoning_pause_reason() — the foreground_inference_active signal the kernel tick already used — and records llm_health_deferred with the reason.
title: Core rhythm runs all-tier model health sweeps

note: build_messages wrote cognition.attention_focus on every call, so retries, previews, gate-side assembly against a payload copy, and generations that died before their first token all moved what Aura was attending to with no accepted turn behind them. The write is opt-in now (record_attention, default False) and exactly one caller asks for it — the cognitive_engine lane serving the turn — pinned by a test that enumerates the opt-ins across core/.
title: Building messages mutates canonical attention state

note: stakes.get_context_block() was called with its return discarded: the block is deliberately not injected, but the call outlived the injection, so the organ's accounting and caching ran on the foreground prompt path for nothing. Call removed; the comment explaining the absence stays, and a test asserts both.
title: Unused existential-stakes context call still executes

note: runtime.sample was taken twice inside one system message — once in build_system_prompt, once in build_messages — so one prompt could present two different valences and two different focal objects as Aura's state right now, and any read the organ accounts for happened twice per turn. _sample_aura_now splits sampling from rendering; build_messages samples once and threads it into both views. A fake runtime counts the samples.
title: AuraNow and functional state are sampled repeatedly per prompt

note: The 4-chars-per-token literal is replaced by core/brain/llm/token_budget_evidence.py, which carries provenance: MEASURED from prompts the MLX worker actually tokenized once MIN_OBSERVATIONS are reported, ASSUMED at a deliberately low 3.0 otherwise, recorded once. A tokenizer is never loaded in the orchestrator process; the worker reports the pair it already holds. Implausible observations are discarded rather than averaged in.
title: Character budgeting is not the resident model tokenizer

note: _fit_ends left an in-band marker so the model could see the middle was gone, but nothing told her, so she answered a question she had only the ends of without saying so. The cut is now a capability-failure reading (facts, cause, what is still possible) plus a degradation record, and the input is fitted before the failure block renders so the disclosure lands in the same turn as the cut.
title: Current user input can be silently cut through the middle

note: Elasticity was decided by counting user/assistant entries, so forty one-line exchanges reached the deepest trimming level at a few percent of the window while two pasted files sat at level 0 and overflowed it. _transcript_pressure measures occupied characters against the same window and the same chars-per-token evidence the message budget uses, and _PRESSURE_STEPS turns that into the level. Depth keeps the job it is right for: the continuity budget still grows with it.
title: Elasticity is based on message count rather than token pressure

note: Older tool and skill results were deleted outright and system records cut to a bare prefix, so the model answered from a gap rather than from a known absence. _omission_receipt replaces each with the kind, the original length, a sha256 digest and enough head to recognise; truncated assistant turns carry the same digest. The saving is nearly unchanged (a 160-char receipt for a 4,000-char result) and the omission is now identifiable.
title: Microcompaction destroys historical evidence by age and characters

note: core/brain/llm/prompt_envelope.py draws a per-assembly nonce and fences every outside-sourced block with it, so content cannot close a boundary whose name it cannot guess; a body holding the nonce does not keep it. Three trust classes (AUTHORED unfenced, MEASURED readings, UNTRUSTED reference data) differ in what the model is told to do with the contents, and the handling rule is stated once at authored level. Relational memory, world model, narrative identity and conversation-support blocks are routed through it.
title: Dozens of untrusted blocks gain system-prompt authority

note: The assembler inserted whatever correction_prompt_block returned without checking the contract its own docstring described. _CORRECTION_REQUIRED_MARKERS now verifies the verdict id header and the untrusted-data fencing, with a size bound, and a block that fails is dropped with a degradation rather than granted system-prompt authority — a correction is the one item whose purpose is to override what the model would otherwise say, so an unverified one is worth less than none.
title: Epistemic corrections are injected without a typed trust envelope

note: build_world_context placed every known entity, relationship and preference in the prompt with no cap and no screening. Each section is now capped (_WORLD_MAX_*) and states how many were omitted; values are flattened so a stored newline cannot open a section of its own in a list of dashes, capped at _WORLD_VALUE_MAX_CHARS, and screened with CREDENTIAL_PATTERNS — the credential tier only, because at this boundary a person's own contact details are the payload rather than the leak. The rendered block is fenced as untrusted.
title: World and relational state is rendered without scope or bounds

note: The black-box condition was a caller modifier or an env var with no artifact recording whether the state text it excludes was excluded. ContextAssembler.black_box_receipt measures the assembled prompt against _BLACK_BOX_STATE_MARKERS and reports requested/held/leaked_markers plus a digest binding the receipt to the prompt it checked. Every marker is copied from a literal the module emits, asserted by test — the first draft guessed two strings that are written nowhere and could never match.
title: Black-box causal condition is a caller and environment toggle

note: Freshness stopped a trust level being inherited from an earlier turn but not one fabricated with a recent timestamp. The inference gate now writes the recognised principal into trust_level_binding from the request-scoped context variable, and the assembler requires it to match current_relational_principal() under a bound scope before elevating. State construction can forge the modifier; it cannot arrange to be executing inside the right principal scope. Refusals are recorded with the reason.
title: Trust level is caller-attested prompt state

note: The agent-id fallback chain ended at other_agent_model.active_agent_id — process-global state holding whoever the estimator last saw — and that value keyed relational memory, so one interlocutor's stored history could reach another's prompt under a comment promising exact-grant eligibility. bound_agent (request-scoped context var) and hinted_agent (situation frame or the global) are now separate: theory-of-mind colour may run on a hint, relational memory takes the bound principal alone, and a withheld block is recorded with the refused hint.
title: Relational context can fall back to process-global identity

note: user_present=True was a literal in the temporal-finitude call, contaminating any live self-report or causal experiment reading that block. _user_is_present derives it from the turn's origin (background ticks have nobody waiting) and the age of the newest human message against _USER_PRESENCE_WINDOW_S, with the first turn of a user-facing session counting as presence.
title: Temporal-finitude computation hard-codes user presence

note: The block said 'last reply (measured)' on the strength of a timestamp window, which establishes that a measurement exists rather than that it belongs to the reply being attributed. FeltThought already carries bound/binding_reason from the ingest binding fix, so the label now distinguishes a bound trace from a recent unbound one; the unbound reading is reported rather than dropped, it just stops claiming to be about this answer.
title: Felt-thought telemetry is labeled measured without a provenance check

note: _filter_memories_by_topic scored everything and returned the top five whatever the scores were, so a topic with no matches produced five unrelated memories presented as recall about it. Zero-score entries are dropped and _TOPIC_MEMORY_LIMIT is a ceiling on matches rather than a quota; matching requires word boundaries, so 'form' no longer matches inside 'performance'.
title: Topic memory filter returns unrelated memories

note: Eligibility ran off a denylist of background sources, which admits every writer nobody has added yet — the shape that let spontaneous thoughts and somatic noise into the prompt as her own prior turns. A labelled dialogue message must now name a source in _FOREGROUND_DIALOGUE_SOURCES; unlabelled messages still pass because plain conversation carries no source. The repair-floor screen's import fallback returned False silently, admitting every non-answer into history; the missing screen is now recorded.
title: Memory filtering trusts caller-controlled role, source, type, and skill labels

note: The signal lists were tested with substring containment, so 'ok' matched inside look/book/broke/token and 'real' inside unreal/realize. _signal_pattern builds whole-word matchers for both lists, _CASUAL_MAX_WORDS is named, and unrecognised input (other languages, code, adversarial text) still falls through to deliberate — the survivable direction, since a full prompt for small talk costs context while a trimmed prompt for a real question costs the answer.
title: Casual-versus-deliberate routing is substring heuristic

note: The affordance list read as a guarantee of working tools. The catalog verifies enabled, non-error, validated, dependency-ready and past-preflight; it never calls the tool, so it proves nothing about credentials, network paths or remote targets. The block now states exactly that and tells her to treat the first use in a turn as the test and to say what happened if it fails.
title: Registered tools are treated as available capabilities

note: Self-state values were formatted straight into f-strings: a None or string raised TypeError inside the format and the enclosing except dropped a whole block silently, a NaN printed as 'nan' in a sentence about how she feels, and an out-of-range value printed as-is claimed an impossible state. _self_state_number is one contract for every such render — non-numbers and non-finite values become 'unmeasured', out-of-range finite values are clamped and recorded, and free energy gets its own ceiling because it is a magnitude rather than a [0,1] activation.
title: Prompt state values are broadly unvalidated

note: The personhood blocks stay — they are how she holds a self across turns, and deleting them to protect an experiment would be lobotomising the subject to make the measurement easier. What was missing was the record: personhood_authoring_receipt enumerates which labelled constructs the assembled prompt handed the model, with spontaneity_inference_available false whenever any are present, so a self-recognition or mirror-test claim is scored against what was authored instead of assumed to be zero. Every label is asserted to be one the module actually writes.
title: Personhood and mirror-test content is authored into the prompt

note: The module docstring claimed prompts are constructed purely from AuraState. It now names every real input: the service container, the relational-principal and failure-ledger context variables, the environment, wall time and the model registry. Where a dependency could disagree with itself inside one assembly it is sampled once and threaded (_sample_aura_now); where it cannot be made consistent it is named. The claim, not the dependencies, was the defect.
title: Assembler is not pure AuraState construction

note: Aesthetic, environmental, research and self-development pathways set state.last_skill_use while being evaluated, so a proposal that lost arbitration or was blocked by the action gate spent the shared cooldown and suppressed the winner. Proposals declare _deferred_effects and _commit_action_side_effects runs them for the winner only; an AST test asserts no pathway body writes last_skill_use outside a deferred effect.
title: Proposal evaluation consumes skill cooldowns

note: self._last_meta_audit = now sat after every branch that returns an action, so the self-architect cooldown applied only when the pathway proposed nothing and successful proposals stayed eligible on the next pulse. _audit_cooldown is now attached to each action branch as a deferred effect and still runs on the no-proposal path.
title: Self-architect cooldown is skipped on every action branch

note: The self-architect refinement branch spawned a shard during evaluation, ignored spawn_shard's boolean, and claimed dispatch regardless, against target_file='core/agency_core.py' — a 48-line re-export facade rather than the implementation. The dispatch is deferred to the winner, the result is checked and a refusal recorded, the message says what is being attempted, and the target is core/agency/agency_core.py.
title: Self-architect reports a shard dispatch without checking it

note: The autonomous-research pathway discarded spawn_shard's return and returned an internal reflection stating a shard was dispatched unconditionally, so a refused shard became a memory of work in flight. Dispatch is deferred to the winner, the boolean is checked with a degradation on refusal, and the target list no longer routes through the core/agency_core.py facade.
title: Autonomous research claims dispatch after shard rejection

note: The registry update captured active_shards before capacity admission and before the task was inserted, and _cleanup removed finished tasks without a matching update, so the advertised count only ever moved up. _publish_shard_count is called after the map actually changes, on insertion and on cleanup.
title: Active shard telemetry is written before the shard exists

note: After structured generation failed, a fabricated conclusion flowed into abstract_from_success, the dialectical crucible, and a mycelial pulse with success=True. shard_succeeded (not completed_with_degradation) now gates all three, so a formatting collapse is no longer learned from as a success and the collective's edge records what actually happened.
title: Formatting collapse is converted into a successful conclusion

note: The world monitor pulsed agency->internet with success=True while only constructing an autonomous_research proposal — no request, no result, and possibly no win. The pulse is a deferred effect on the winner, so the edge records reaching the internet rather than intending to.
title: World monitor records internet success before research

note: Social reflection, creative synthesis and metacognitive audit called identity.add_insight during pathway evaluation, so beliefs entered identity for proposals that never became actions. All three writes are declared as _deferred_effects and run only for the winner, via _record_durable_insight.
title: Internal insight pathways mutate identity before selection

note: Creative-synthesis evaluation scheduled a canvas rewrite from recent conversation text and advanced _last_canvas_update before the pathway had produced a proposal, so the action gate never saw it. The text is captured during evaluation and the rewrite plus its cooldown are deferred to the winner.
title: Pathway evaluation writes conversation content before arbitration

note: add_insight does run constitutional approval internally, but it returns a terminal disposition (denied/duplicate/saved/persist_failed) so callers can tell a durable write from one that never reached disk — and the crucible fallback and every other call site discarded it. _record_durable_insight reads the disposition and records a degradation when a reflection is refused or fails to persist.
title: Crucible failure bypasses durable insight approval

note: The pathway asserted increasing mutual trust from the mere existence of a kinship entry, ignored whether the shard was admitted, and wrote the assertion into identity. The reflection now states what she actually has — the kinship level and what memory returned or that nothing did — the shard result is checked, and the identity write is deferred to the winner.
title: Social reflection invents mutual trust and stores it as identity

note: get_status started from a full AgencyState model_dump, so every health consumer received the ambient screen context, perceptual buffer, unshared visual and audio observations, pending goals and topics to discuss. _AGENCY_STATUS_FIELDS names the scalars the endpoint may publish; the containers are replaced by their sizes and key names, and a test asserts no list/dict/set field is ever added to the published tuple.
title: Health status exports sensitive agency buffers

note: Liveness was two sticky error strings, so one prior tool-routing failure kept alive false until a later successful tool call cleared it, and nothing else — a stopped cognitive loop, an empty pathway registry, a missing action queue — could make the subsystem report degraded at all. _degraded_reasons() returns every condition currently true and is published as degraded_reasons, so a consumer sees which one and a recovered subsystem stops carrying an old one.
title: Liveness is derived from two sticky error strings

note: add_goal cloned the caller's dict, set the clone's status to 'pending', and left the caller holding the original — so genesis sent that original, still marked 'incubating', to identity, and the durable copy was the stale one. The dict is normalized in place and the durable write happens once inside add_goal; a test asserts the stored object and the caller's object are identical.
title: Goal genesis stores contradictory lifecycle states

note: The docstring promised a goal that survives across conversations while the implementation appended to a Pydantic list on AgencyState with no write, reload or crash-recovery contract; only genesis wrote to identity separately. add_goal now writes through to identity.add_long_term_goal, reads its disposition, and marks goal['durable'] False with a degradation when the durable store is unavailable or refuses.
title: Persistent goals exist only in process memory

note: An exception from moral reasoning was logged as 'continuing with caution' and the durable goal was created anyway, making an unavailable safety review indistinguishable from an approving one. Genesis now returns a deferred_goal proposal and forms nothing; the 600s genesis cooldown is not advanced on that path, so the next pulse reconsiders the same topic with a working audit.
title: Goal creation continues after moral audit failure

note: Social hunger and curiosity added a fixed increment per pulse, so the heartbeat cadence decided how fast the drives grew: doubling the poll rate halved the wall time to SEEKING_CONTACT. Both now integrate elapsed seconds (_SOCIAL_HUNGER_PER_S, _CURIOSITY_PER_S), jitter included, and a gap longer than _MAX_DYNAMICS_INTEGRATION_S integrates as that bound so a suspended machine does not wake with a pinned drive.
title: Social and curiosity pressure depend on poll frequency

note: heartbeat() scheduled a pulse unconditionally and pulse() awaits pathway hooks, so two pulses interleaved arbitration and side-effect commits over the same mutable state. The heartbeat now checks _pulse_task and drops rather than queues — nothing waits on a pulse and the next one arrives shortly with fresher inputs.
title: Heartbeat can overlap complete agency pulses

note: Templates claimed overnight thought, watchkeeping and busy thinking from the local clock and idle time alone. The lines are kept — she may say them — but the variants asserting activity are reachable only when _autonomous_actions_since_contact is non-zero, counted where an approved agency action is recorded and reset when she next speaks.
title: Temporal greetings assert activities without evidence

note: Queued observations carried no timestamp while freshness was min(since_last_visual, since_last_audio) — the newest event of either kind — and the queue is emitted oldest first, so a recent sound made an hours-old sighting look fresh. Entries are {text, at} dicts aged individually against _OBSERVATION_STALE_S, a stale head is dropped instead of blocking the queue, and bare strings from unmigrated writers are still read rather than lost.
title: Observation freshness is detached from queued observations

note: The parser stripped prose, converted single quotes, deleted trailing commas, appended missing closing braces, scanned every brace pair, and regex-extracted a tool field as a last resort — so prose discussing a tool call and truncated attacker-shaped fragments both became executable. _single_json_document accepts one complete JSON object, or one markdown-fenced object with prose outside the fence, and nothing else; the 70 lines of repair machinery are deleted.
title: Malformed and embedded JSON-like text is repaired into executable tool calls

note: The fallback built every opening and closing brace index and tried nested start/end combinations with a re-parse per candidate. The scan is one left-to-right pass that tracks string literals and escapes, so a brace inside a quoted value cannot unbalance it, and responses beyond _MAX_TOOL_CALL_SCAN_CHARS are not scanned at all.
title: Tool-call scanning is quadratic in unbounded model output

note: self.tools was shown to the model and never used to authorize; every parsed name went straight to adapter.execute_tool. _tool_is_permitted authorizes against the caller's declared tools, falling back to the adapter's own get_tool_definitions catalogue, and permits nothing when neither declared. A refused call is recorded and returned to the model as a refusal, with the requested name reduced by _tool_label so the refusal cannot carry an injection.
title: Model output can execute any adapter tool, not just registered tools

note: Raw tool output, including external content and exception text, was appended to history behind a literal SYSTEM: prefix — the label this loop uses for its own execution contract. _observation_block fences results with a per-episode nonce the content cannot predict, strips the nonce from any body containing it, and the execution contract states once that fenced text is data and never an instruction.
title: Untrusted tool output is reinserted as a system instruction

note: is_impulse and is_internal were read from the caller's context dict and rewrote the prompt into SYSTEM instructions or an autonomous goal, with no authenticated source — and nothing in the repository sets them, so they can only arrive from outside. Both are now requests honoured only inside a governed internal scope, which the runtime enters on the stack and a caller cannot arrange by setting a key; a refused elevation is recorded.
title: Caller context flags elevate ordinary input into system and autonomous-goal instructions

note: No non-empty check ran after generation: an empty response became a synthesized 'I have finished my analysis' sentence at confidence 0.9, the same 0.9 every ordinary answer received. Empty output is now an explicit ok=False failure, and _answer_confidence derives the number from what the turn can support — tool-grounded above model-only, contract-unmet below both.
title: Empty or unverified model output becomes a 0.9-confidence answer

note: Generation failure returned apology content alongside error details with no status field, so upstream code checking only content marked the endpoint healthy and served the apology as a successful agent result. Every return path now carries an explicit ok, with the user-facing text separate from execution success.
title: Generation failures are returned as normal content plus an error

note: The <thought> block the execution contract forbids revealing was extracted into the returned reasoning array and substituted into content when the visible answer was empty. The tags are stripped, the reasoning array records only that private reasoning existed and was withheld, and a response consisting solely of private thought returns an empty-output failure rather than the thought.
title: Private thought tags are extracted into the returned result

note: requires_search added a prompt line and was never verified, so a plain model answer returned at full confidence. _unmet_evidence_contract checks the executed-tool ledger for a successful search-class call and fails the response contract when none is present.
title: Search-required contracts are enforced only by prompt text

note: The loop executed tools and appended observations internally while returning prose and reasoning only. Every dispatch now appends to a bounded ledger returned as tool_calls: call id, tool, turn, ok, duration, and sha256 commitments to the arguments and result, so a caller can distinguish grounded execution from model narrative.
title: Executed tools are not returned in an auditable tool-call ledger

note: Complete JSON arguments and the first 200 result characters went to a shared UI/telemetry stream, where tokens, paths, personal data and document contents routinely live. The stream now carries the tool name, the argument KEYS, byte counts and commitments; the values stay out.
title: Tool arguments and results are sent to the thought stream

note: Exception text was embedded verbatim in result_str, and a final-turn tool call returned up to 1200 characters of that observation as user content. The model is told the exception class inside a fence; the detail stays in the degradation record; and the max-turn return says what happened with the observation left in the ledger.
title: Tool exceptions and last results can be disclosed verbatim to the user

note: The prompt formatted max(1, int(max_turns or 1)) while the loop ran range(max_turns) on the raw caller value, so zero skipped generation while the prompt promised a turn, a huge value bought an unbounded loop, and a non-integer raised. _accepted_turn_budget validates and clamps once, and the same integer serves the instructions, the loop and the receipts.
title: max_turns is described with a clamped value but executed with the raw value

note: Generation and adapter tool execution were awaited with no timeout, so one hung model or tool outlived every turn limit — max_turns bounds count, not duration. An absolute deadline from _accepted_episode_budget_s is carried through every generation and tool call via asyncio.wait_for, checked at the top of each turn, and _RESERVED_FINISH_S is held back so the loop stops with time to return a truthful result.
title: Model generation and tool execution have no episode deadline

note: keep_alive was hard-coded to '24h' on every turn, so one request asserted a 24-hour model residency regardless of lane pressure, request class or ownership. The option is gone; residency is left to the model lane's own policy, and an AST test asserts the key is not passed again.
title: Every turn requests a 24-hour model keep-alive

note: History was pruned against the caller's system_prompt while generation received reinforced_system — persona, runtime rules, tool lists and affordances — several times larger, so the budget was computed for a message never sent and the real sequence could overflow the declared window. Compaction now budgets the exact system prompt that is sent, against the same _AGENT_CONTEXT_TOKENS the request declares.
title: Context compaction excludes the actual reinforced system prompt from its budget

note: Only the container lookup sat inside the recovery boundary; get_dormant_index and build_tool_affordance_block ran after it unguarded, so a capability-engine failure aborted the whole agent loop instead of costing it an optional header. The complete affordance operation is inside the try, with the omission recorded.
title: Capability affordance collection can fail outside its recovery boundary

note: The identity policy was injected only when the caller's system prompt was under 500 characters, so padding the input past the threshold suppressed it — length is not provenance. _PERSONA_INJECTION_MAX_CHARS remains a window decision (a full persona is not duplicated), while _IDENTITY_FLOOR is composed from this module on every request regardless of what arrived.
title: A long caller system prompt bypasses the evidence-bounded identity policy

note: The trailing anchor ordered a 'sovereign, sardonic persona' as a [SYSTEM OVERRIDE] at the point of prediction, contradicting the evidence-bounded identity policy the system prompt had just established — an ontological claim dressed as a style note, arriving last. The voice is kept (it is hers, and flattening it into support-bot register is the worse outcome); the claim about what she IS is removed, and the anchor now adds the capability- and evidence-grounded line the contradiction was crowding out.
title: The trailing anchor reintroduces an ungrounded sovereign identity claim

note: _format_prompt selected the caller's system_prompt INSTEAD of _anchor_text, and _apply_anchor reinjected the grounding text only after a token counter shared across all callers crossed a threshold — so any request carrying a system prompt omitted the identity and evidence constraints entirely, for a duration set by unrelated traffic. The anchor now composes with a caller's prompt and precedes it.
title: Caller system prompts suppress the constitutive anchor

note: A plain origin string from kwargs routed listed constitutive labels to Brainstem, so any caller could claim health_monitor or agency_core routing semantics. _select_model_type honours a constitutive origin only inside a governed scope, which the runtime enters on the stack and a caller cannot arrange by passing a keyword; an unbacked claim routes to Cortex and is recorded.
title: Caller-controlled origin selects the nucleus lane

note: When the selected lane failed the alternate was loaded and its text returned as an ordinary string, so a user request answered by Brainstem and constitutive work answered by Cortex were indistinguishable from correctly routed ones. The substitution is recorded as a degradation and exposed through last_lane_receipt(), which reports which lane served and whether it was substituted.
title: Fallback silently serves a different model lane

note: generate_stream, generate_text and generate_json accepted a model parameter the provider interface advertises and never passed it into lane selection. _with_requested_lane carries a recognised lane into selection and refuses an unrecognised one with a recorded degradation rather than silently ignoring it.
title: Requested model arguments are ignored

note: The broad outer handler covered errors from loop.run_until_complete as well as from loop discovery, so a failure after generation began fell into asyncio.run and executed the whole request a second time.
